Keyboard-friendly: focusable,\n  // Enter/Space toggles. Leaf rows (.leaf-row) are inert — no listener attached.\n  function initTreeToggle() {\n    document.querySelectorAll('.tree-row.branch-row').forEach(function (row) {\n      row.setAttribute('tabindex', '0');\n      row.setAttribute('role', 'button');\n      var kids = row.nextElementSibling;\n      row.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(kids ? !kids.classList.contains('tree-collapsed') : false));\n      function toggle() {\n        var children = row.nextElementSibling;\n        if (!children || !children.classList.contains('tree-children')) return;\n        var collapsed = children.classList.toggle('tree-collapsed');\n        var tgl = row.querySelector('.tree-toggle');\n        if (tgl) tgl.textContent = collapsed ? '+' : '−'; // − (minus)\n        row.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(!collapsed));\n      }\n      row.addEventListener('click', toggle);\n      row.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {\n        if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') { e.preventDefault(); toggle(); }\n      });\n    });\n  }\n\n  // ── VIEW TOGGLE (index.html home page: grid ↔ grouped list) ────────\n  function initViewToggle() {\n    var btnG = document.getElementById('vbtn-grid');\n    var btnL = document.getElementById('vbtn-list');\n    var gv   = document.getElementById('grid-view');\n    var lv   = document.getElementById('list-view');\n    if (!btnG || !btnL || !gv) return;\n\n    btnG.addEventListener('click', function () {\n      btnG.classList.add('active');   btnL.classList.remove('active');\n      gv.style.display = '';\n      if (lv) lv.style.display = 'none';\n    });\n    btnL.addEventListener('click', function () {\n      btnL.classList.add('active');   btnG.classList.remove('active');\n      gv.style.display = 'none';\n      if (lv) lv.style.display = '';\n    });\n\n    // Collapsible super-groups in list view\n    document.querySelectorAll('.sg-hdr').forEach(function (h) {\n      var rows = h.nextElementSibling;\n      if (!rows) return;\n      h.addEventListener('click', function () {\n        h.classList.toggle('sg-closed');\n        rows.classList.toggle('sg-hidden');\n      });\n    });\n  }\n\n  // ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n  // PHASE 2 — TREE ROW EDITOR (schema.html / vocabulary.html /\n  // corespines-set.html only — self-detects via .tree-row presence;\n  // zero HTML edits, FE-I2 single-JS honored). DOM-based operations +\n  // localStorage persistence + Blob-download + window.print(). No\n  // framework. Never writes to disk/git — captures a changeset for\n  // Opus to review + commit (§1.7).\n  // ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n  function escapeHtml(s) {\n    return String(s).replace(/[&<>\"']/g, function (c) {\n      return { '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '\"': '&quot;', \"'\": '&#39;' }[c];\n    });\n  }\n\n  function safeName(s) { return String(s).replace(/[^a-z0-9.\\-]/gi, '_'); }\n\n  function downloadBlob(filename, content, mime) {\n    var blob = new Blob([content], { type: mime || 'text/plain' });\n    var url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);\n    var a = document.createElement('a');\n    a.href = url; a.download = filename;\n    document.body.appendChild(a); a.click(); document.body.removeChild(a);\n    setTimeout(function () { URL.revokeObjectURL(url); }, 1000);\n  }\n\n  function initTreeEditor() {\n    if (!document.querySelector('.tree-row')) return; // only tree pages\n\n    var CHKEY = 'cisem-changeset:' + (location.pathname.split('/').pop() || 'page');\n\n    function loadChangeset() {\n      try {\n        var raw = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(CHKEY));\n        return raw || defaultChangeset();\n      } catch (e) { return defaultChangeset(); }\n    }\n    function defaultChangeset() {\n      return { adds: [], deletes: [], order: {}, comments: {}, uploads: {}, moved: [] };\n    }\n    function saveChangeset(cs) {\n      try { localStorage.setItem(CHKEY, JSON.stringify(cs)); }\n      catch (e) { window.alert('CISEM editor: could not save (storage limit reached). Export your changeset, then clear an upload to free space.'); }\n    }\n\n    // ── nid assignment: deterministic path from each tree root's DOM order ──\n    function assignTreeIds() {\n      function walk(ul, nid) {\n        ul.setAttribute('data-nid', nid);\n        var idx = 0;\n        Array.prototype.forEach.call(ul.children, function (li) {\n          if (!li.classList || !li.classList.contains('tree-node')) return;\n          var childNid = nid + '.' + idx;\n          li.setAttribute('data-nid', childNid);\n          idx++;\n          var childUl = li.querySelector(':scope > ul.tree-children');\n          if (childUl) walk(childUl, childNid);\n        });\n      }\n      document.querySelectorAll('ul.tree').forEach(function (rootUl, ti) { walk(rootUl, 't' + ti); });\n    }\n\n    function promoteToBranch(li) {\n      var row = li.querySelector(':scope > .tree-row');\n      if (!row || row.classList.contains('branch-row')) return;\n      row.classList.remove('leaf-row');\n      row.classList.add('branch-row');\n      var tgl = row.querySelector('.tree-toggle');\n      if (tgl) { tgl.classList.remove('leaf'); tgl.textContent = '−'; }\n      row.setAttribute('tabindex', '0');\n      row.setAttribute('role', 'button');\n      row.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');\n      row.addEventListener('click', function (e) {\n        if (e.target.closest('.rt-tools')) return;\n        var kidsUl = li.querySelector(':scope > ul.tree-children');\n        if (!kidsUl) return;\n        var collapsed = kidsUl.classList.toggle('tree-collapsed');\n        var t = row.querySelector('.tree-toggle');\n        if (t) t.textContent = collapsed ? Run: node functional-check.mjs\n// Governed by CS-FRONTEND-001; feeds the web-page completion learning loop (Principle 17 / RI-0007).\nimport { JSDOM } from 'jsdom';\nimport fs from 'node:fs';\nimport path from 'node:path';\nimport { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';\n\nconst HERE = path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));\nconst ROOT = path.resolve(HERE, '..', '..'); fails.push(name); } }\n\nfunction load(rel) {\n  const html = fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, 'frontend/pages', rel), 'utf8');\n  const dom = new JSDOM(html, { runScripts: 'outside-only', pretendToBeVisual: true,\n    url: 'http://localhost/frontend/pages/' + rel });\n  const w = dom.window;\n  w.matchMedia = w.matchMedia || function () { return { matches: false, addListener() {}, removeListener() {}, addEventListener() {}, removeEventListener() {} }; };\n  w.print = w.print || function () {};\n  w.eval(JS);   // IIFE runs init() immediately (readyState = 'complete')\n  return w;\n}\nfunction click(w, el) { el.dispatchEvent(new w.window.Event('click', { bubbles: true, cancelable: true })); }\n\n// ── schema.html — the page the Governor found broken ──\nconst w = load('schema.html');\nconst doc = w.document;\n\nconst branch = doc.querySelector('.tree-row.branch-row');\nok('schema: a branch row exists', !!branch);\nif (branch) {\n  const li = branch.parentElement;\n  const kids = li.querySelector(':scope > ul.tree-children');\n  ok('schema: branch has a child <ul>', !!kids);\n  if (kids) {\n    const before = kids.classList.contains('tree-collapsed');\n    click(w, branch);\n    const afterFirst = kids.classList.contains('tree-collapsed');\n    ok('schema: clicking a branch row CHANGES collapse state (behavioral, not just wired)', before !== afterFirst);\n    click(w, branch);\n    ok('schema: second click toggles back', kids.classList.contains('tree-collapsed') === before);\n  }\n}\n\n// ── universal chrome toggles (present + behavioral) on schema.html ──\nconst themeBtn = doc.querySelector('.theme-tgl');\nok('theme toggle injected', !!themeBtn);\nif (themeBtn) {\n  const t0 = doc.documentElement.getAttribute('data-theme') || '';\n  click(w, themeBtn);\n  ok('theme toggle changes data-theme', (doc.documentElement.getAttribute('data-theme') || '') !== t0);\n}\nconst langBtn = doc.querySelector('.lang-tgl');\nok('language toggle injected', !!langBtn);\nif (langBtn) {\n  const d0 = doc.documentElement.getAttribute('dir') || 'ltr';\n  click(w, langBtn);\n  ok('language toggle flips dir', (doc.documentElement.getAttribute('dir') || 'ltr') !== d0);\n}\n\n// ── a content page (Rows/Window toggle must actually reshape, not be dead) ──\nconst w2 = load('principles.html');\nconst viewBtns = w2.document.querySelectorAll('.vbtn');\nok('principles: Rows/Window view buttons exist', viewBtns.length >= 2);\nif (viewBtns.length >= 2) {\n  const body = w2.document.body;\n  const win = Array.prototype.find.call(viewBtns, b => /window/i.test(b.textContent));\n  if (win) { click(w2, win); ok('principles: Window view applies a body class (behavioral)', /view-window/.test(body.className)); }\n  else ok('principles: a Window view button is labelled', false);\n}\n\nconsole.log('CISEM FRONTEND FUNCTIONAL CHECK');\nconsole.log('  ' + pass + ' pass, ' + fail + ' fail');\nif (fail) { console.log('  FAILURES:'); Catches the class of bug where a listener is wired but does nothing\n// (e.g. collapse toggle bailing because a panel broke nextElementSibling). Run: node functional-check.mjs\n// Governed by CS-FRONTEND-001; feeds the web-page completion learning loop (Principle 17 / RI-0007).\nimport { JSDOM } from 'jsdom';\nimport fs from 'node:fs';\nimport path from 'node:path';\nimport { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';\n\nconst HERE = path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));\nconst ROOT = path.resolve(HERE, '..', '..');           // repo root\nconst JS = fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, 'frontend/js/search.js'), 'utf8');\n\nlet pass = 0, fail = 0;\nconst fails = [];\nfunction ok(name, cond) { if (cond) { pass++; } else { fail++; fails.push(name); } }\n\nfunction load(rel) {\n  const html = fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, 'frontend/pages', rel), 'utf8');\n  const dom = new JSDOM(html, { runScripts: 'outside-only', pretendToBeVisual: true,\n    url: 'http://localhost/frontend/pages/' + rel });\n  const w = dom.window;\n  w.matchMedia = w.matchMedia || function () { return { matches: false, addListener() {}, removeListener() {}, addEventListener() {}, removeEventListener() {} }; };\n  w.print = w.print || function () {};\n  w.eval(JS);   // IIFE runs init() immediately (readyState = 'complete')\n  return w;\n}\nfunction click(w, el) { el.dispatchEvent(new w.window.Event('click', { bubbles: true, cancelable: true })); }\n\n// ── schema.html — the page the Governor found broken ──\nconst w = load('schema.html');\nconst doc = w.document;\n\nconst branch = doc.querySelector('.tree-row.branch-row');\nok('schema: a branch row exists', !!branch);\nif (branch) {\n  const li = branch.parentElement;\n  const kids = li.querySelector(':scope > ul.tree-children');\n  ok('schema: branch has a child <ul>', !!kids);\n  if (kids) {\n    const before = kids.classList.contains('tree-collapsed');\n    click(w, branch);\n    const afterFirst = kids.classList.contains('tree-collapsed');\n    ok('schema: clicking a branch row CHANGES collapse state (behavioral, not just wired)', before !== afterFirst);\n    click(w, branch);\n    ok('schema: second click toggles back', kids.classList.contains('tree-collapsed') === before);\n  }\n}\n\n// ── universal chrome toggles (present + behavioral) on schema.html ──\nconst themeBtn = doc.querySelector('.theme-tgl');\nok('theme toggle injected', !!themeBtn);\nif (themeBtn) {\n  const t0 = doc.documentElement.getAttribute('data-theme') || '';\n  click(w, themeBtn);\n  ok('theme toggle changes data-theme', (doc.documentElement.getAttribute('data-theme') || '') !== t0);\n}\nconst langBtn = doc.querySelector('.lang-tgl');\nok('language toggle injected', !!langBtn);\nif (langBtn) {\n  const d0 = doc.documentElement.getAttribute('dir') || 'ltr';\n  click(w, langBtn);\n  ok('language toggle flips dir', (doc.documentElement.getAttribute('dir') || 'ltr') !== d0);\n}\n\n// ── a content page (Rows/Window toggle must actually reshape, not be dead) ──\nconst w2 = load('principles.html');\nconst viewBtns = w2.document.querySelectorAll('.vbtn');\nok('principles: Rows/Window view buttons exist', viewBtns.length >= 2);\nif (viewBtns.length >= 2) {\n  const body = w2.document.body;\n  const win = Array.prototype.find.call(viewBtns, b => /window/i.test(b.textContent));\n  if (win) { click(w2, win); ok('principles: Window view applies a body class (behavioral)', /view-window/.test(body.className)); }\n  else ok('principles: a Window view button is labelled', false);\n}\n\nconsole.log('CISEM FRONTEND FUNCTIONAL CHECK');\nconsole.log('  ' + pass + ' pass, ' + fail + ' fail');\nif (fail) { console.log('  FAILURES:'); fails.forEach(f => console.log('   ✗ ' + f)); }\nelse console.log('  ✅ ALL INTERACTIVE ELEMENTS BEHAVIORALLY VERIFIED');\nprocess.exit(fail ? 1 : 0);\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":22,"oldLines":7,"newStart":22,"newLines":8,"lines":["   const w = dom.window;","   w.matchMedia = w.matchMedia || function () { return { matches: false, addListener() {}, removeListener() {}, addEventListener() {}, removeEventListener() {} }; No inline `style=\"\"` attributes, no page-specific CSS files.\n63\t\n64\t**FE-I2 Single JS file.** Every page must `<script src=\"[../]js/search.js\"></script>` at body-close. No inline scripts, no page-specific JS. All behavior lives in search.js.\n65\t\n66\t**FE-I3 Standard nav.** Nav must contain in order: `.logo` link → `.idx` dropdown (all 20 groups) → `.nav-search` with `id=\"si\"` + `id=\"cnt\"` → `.nav-r` with ✎ and ? icons. No additional nav elements without corespine update.\n67\t\n68\t**FE-I4 Breadcrumb row.** Every page must have `.bc` div containing `bc-arr` back + forward buttons followed by the breadcrumb trail. Placed immediately after `</nav>`.\n69\t\n70\t**FE-I5 Design-system tokens only.** No hardcoded hex/rgb color values outside `:root` in style.css. All visual decisions flow through `--bg`, `--nav`, `--border`, `--text`, `--muted`, `--accent`, `--hover`.\n71\t\n72\t**FE-I6 Responsive layout.** All layouts use CSS Grid or Flexbox. No fixed-width containers. Minimum supported viewport: 320px. No horizontal overflow. Tested breakpoints: 320px, 768px, 1200px.\n73\t\n74\t**FE-I7 Cell / mobile.** Nav must remain functional and non-overflowing at 320px. Touch targets ≥ 44×44px for primary interactive elements (nav links, buttons, `.fi a`). Dropdown must not break on small viewports.\n75\t\n76\t**FE-I8 Dead-link-free.** Every `href=\"../../...\"` relative link must resolve on disk before commit. Verified by `bash frontend/rebuild.sh`. Dead links are a ZF finding.\n77\t\n78\t**FE-I9 Collapsible sections.** `.sh` section headers on group pages must have JS-driven collapse/expand (initCollapse() in search.js). `.sh` without a following `.fl` is exempt.\n79\t\n80\t**FE-I10 Rows / Window view toggle.** Group pages with `.fi` file items must expose a Rows/Window view toggle. This is auto-injected by `initPageViewToggle()` in search.js — no manual HTML required.\n81\t\n82\t---\n83\t"}]},"uuid":"6cabb9a5-f291-4d92-ac2c-64c1e778c7a4","timestamp":"2026-07-20T19:33:37.441Z","toolUseResult":{"type":"text","file":{"filePath":"c:\\Users\\finky\\Desktop\\Claude Code\\Cisem\\dna\\corespines\\CS-FRONTEND-001\\CISEM-ARCH-00393-frontend-corespine-manifest.md","content":"## §IV Invariants (FE-I1 – FE-I10)\n\n**FE-I1 Single stylesheet.** Every page must `<link>` only `css/style.css`. No inline `style=\"\"` attributes, no page-specific CSS files.\n\n**FE-I2 Single JS file.** Every page must `<script src=\"[../]js/search.js\"></script>` at body-close. No inline scripts, no page-specific JS. Catches the class of bug where a listener is wired but does nothing\n// (e.g. collapse toggle bailing because a panel broke nextElementSibling). Run: node functional-check.mjs\n// Governed by CS-FRONTEND-001; feeds the web-page completion learning loop (Principle 17 / RI-0007).\nimport { JSDOM, VirtualConsole } from 'jsdom';\nimport fs from 'node:fs';\nimport path from 'node:path';\nimport { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';\n\nconst HERE = path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));\nconst ROOT = path.resolve(HERE, '..', '..');           // repo root\nconst JS = fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, 'frontend/js/search.js'), 'utf8');\n\nlet pass = 0, fail = 0;\nconst fails = [];\nfunction ok(name, cond) { if (cond) { pass++; } else { fail++; fails.push(name); } }\n\nfunction load(rel) {\n  const html = fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, 'frontend/pages', rel), 'utf8');\n  // Capture ANY uncaught error during init (jsdom routes listener exceptions to jsdomError).\n  // A crash on load must FAIL the check — it can no longer hide behind other passing assertions (RI-0008).\n  const loadErrors = [];\n  const vc = new VirtualConsole();\n  vc.on('jsdomError', e => loadErrors.push((e && e.message) || String(e)));\n  const dom = new JSDOM(html, { runScripts: 'outside-only', pretendToBeVisual: true,\n    url: 'http://localhost/frontend/pages/' + rel, virtualConsole: vc });\n  const w = dom.window;\n  w.matchMedia = w.matchMedia || function () { return { matches: false, addListener() {}, removeListener() {}, addEventListener() {}, removeEventListener() {} }; };\n  w.print = w.print || function () {};\n  w.eval(JS);   // registers a DOMContentLoaded listener (jsdom stays in 'loading')\n  w.document.dispatchEvent(new w.Event('DOMContentLoaded', { bubbles: true }));  // fire init()\n  w.__loadErrors = loadErrors;\n  ok(rel + ': loads with NO uncaught error (init did not crash)', loadErrors.length === 0);\n  return w;\n}\nfunction click(w, el) { el.dispatchEvent(new w.window.Event('click', { bubbles: true, cancelable: true })); }\n\n// ── schema.html — the page the Governor found broken ──\nconst w = load('schema.html');\nconst doc = w.document;\n\nconst branch = doc.querySelector('.tree-row.branch-row');\nok('schema: a branch row exists', !!branch);\nif (branch) {\n  const li = branch.parentElement;\n  const kids = li.querySelector(':scope > ul.tree-children');\n  ok('schema: branch has a child <ul>', !!kids);\n  if (kids) {\n    const before = kids.classList.contains('tree-collapsed');\n    click(w, branch);\n    const afterFirst = kids.classList.contains('tree-collapsed');\n    ok('schema: clicking a branch row CHANGES collapse state (behavioral, not just wired)', before !== afterFirst);\n    click(w, branch);\n    ok('schema: second click toggles back', kids.classList.contains('tree-collapsed') === before);\n  }\n}\n\n// ── universal chrome toggles (present + behavioral) on schema.html ──\nconst themeBtn = doc.querySelector('.theme-tgl');\nok('theme toggle injected', !!themeBtn);\nif (themeBtn) {\n  const t0 = doc.documentElement.getAttribute('data-theme') || '';\n  click(w, themeBtn);\n  ok('theme toggle changes data-theme', (doc.documentElement.getAttribute('data-theme') || '') !== t0);\n}\nconst langBtn = doc.querySelector('.lang-tgl');\nok('language toggle injected', !!langBtn);\nif (langBtn) {\n  const d0 = doc.documentElement.getAttribute('dir') || 'ltr';\n  click(w, langBtn);\n  ok('language toggle flips dir', (doc.documentElement.getAttribute('dir') || 'ltr') !== d0);\n}\n\n// ── a content page (Rows/Window toggle must actually reshape, not be dead) ──\nconst w2 = load('principles.html');\nconst viewBtns = w2.document.querySelectorAll('.vbtn');\nok('principles: Rows/Window view buttons exist', viewBtns.length >= 2);\nif (viewBtns.length >= 2) {\n  const body = w2.document.body;\n  const win = Array.prototype.find.call(viewBtns, b => /window/i.test(b.textContent));\n  if (win) { click(w2, win); ok('principles: Window view applies a body class (behavioral)', /view-window/.test(body.className)); }\n  else ok('principles: a Window view button is labelled', false);\n}\n\nconsole.log('CISEM FRONTEND FUNCTIONAL CHECK');\nconsole.log('  ' + pass + ' pass, ' + fail + ' fail');\nif (fail) { console.log('  FAILURES:'); fails.forEach(f => console.log('   ✗ ' + f)); }\nelse console.log('  ✅ ALL INTERACTIVE ELEMENTS BEHAVIORALLY VERIFIED');\nprocess.exit(fail ? 1 : 0);\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":71,"oldLines":16,"newStart":71,"newLines":32,"lines":["   ok('language toggle flips dir', (doc.documentElement.getAttribute('dir') || 'ltr') !== d0);"," }"," ","-// ── a content page (Rows/Window toggle must actually reshape, not be dead) ──","-const w2 = load('principles.html');","-const viewBtns = w2.document.querySelectorAll('.vbtn');","-ok('principles: Rows/Window view buttons exist', viewBtns.length >= 2);","-if (viewBtns.length >= 2) {","-  const body = w2.document.body;","-  const win = Array.prototype.find.call(viewBtns, b => /window/i.test(b.textContent));","-  if (win) { click(w2, win); '\\\\.')).test(CSS));\nok('view-window CSS defines at least the core reshape rules (.fl/.cl/.tier-grid)',\n  ['.fl', '.cl', '.tier-grid'].every(s => RESHAPEABLE.indexOf(s) !== -1));\n\nconst PAGES_DIR 2) {\n    const body = wv.document.body;\n    const win = Array.prototype.find.call(btns, b => /window/i.test(b.textContent));\n    const rows = Array.prototype.find.call(btns, b => If it can't reshape, it MUST NOT be present.\nconst CSS = fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, 'frontend/css/style.css'), 'utf8');\n// content-container selectors that HAVE a body.view-window reshape rule:\nconst RESHAPEABLE = ['.fl', '.fi', '.cl', '.cl-item', '.tier-grid', '.tier-card']\n  .filter(sel => new RegExp('body\\\\.view-window\\\\s+' + sel.replace('.', '\\\\.')).test(CSS));\nok('view-window CSS defines at least the core reshape rules (.fl/.cl/.tier-grid)',\n  ['.fl', '.cl', '.tier-grid'].every(s => RESHAPEABLE.indexOf(s) !== -1));\n\nconst PAGES_DIR = path.join(ROOT, 'frontend/pages');\nconst ALL_PAGES = fs.readdirSync(PAGES_DIR).filter(f => f.endsWith('.html'));\nok('enumerated ALL pages (>= 20, not a sample)', ALL_PAGES.length >= 20);\nALL_PAGES.forEach(function (page) {\n  const wv = load(page);            // load() already asserts no-crash per page\n  const btns = wv.document.querySelectorAll('.vbtn');\n  if (btns.length >= 2) {\n    const body = wv.document.body;\n    const win = Array.prototype.find.call(btns, b => /window/i.test(b.textContent));\n    const rows = Array.prototype.find.call(btns, b => /rows/i.test(b.textContent));\n    ok(page + ': has both Rows and Window buttons', !!win && !!rows);\n    if (win && rows) {\n      click(wv, win);\n      ok(page + ': Window APPLIES view-window (behavioral)', /view-window/.test(body.className));\n      click(wv, rows);\n      ok(page + ': Rows REMOVES view-window (behavioral)', !/view-window/.test(body.className));\n    }\n    // NO DEAD TOGGLE: a page carrying the toggle MUST have reshapeable content on it.\n    const hasReshapeable = RESHAPEABLE.some(sel => wv.document.querySelector(sel));\n    ok(page + ': toggle present => page has content a view-window rule reshapes (no dead toggle)', hasReshapeable);\n  }\n  // pages WITHOUT the toggle (tree pages, placeholders) are fine — nothing to assert.\n});\n\nconsole.log('CISEM FRONTEND FUNCTIONAL CHECK');","originalFile":"// CISEM Frontend Functional Check — BEHAVIORAL verification (clicks + asserts state changes),\n// not listener-presence. Catches the class of bug where a listener is wired but does nothing\n// (e.g. collapse toggle bailing because a panel broke nextElementSibling). Run: node functional-check.mjs\n// Governed by CS-FRONTEND-001; feeds the web-page completion learning loop (Principle 17 / RI-0007).\nimport { JSDOM, VirtualConsole } from 'jsdom';\nimport fs from 'node:fs';\nimport path from 'node:path';\nimport { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';\n\nconst HERE = path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));\nconst ROOT = path.resolve(HERE, '..', '..');           // repo root\nconst JS = fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, 'frontend/js/search.js'), 'utf8');\n\nlet pass = 0, fail = 0;\nconst fails = [];\nfunction ok(name, cond) { if (cond) { pass++; } else { fail++; fails.push(name); } }\n\nfunction load(rel) {\n  const html = fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, 'frontend/pages', rel), 'utf8');\n  // Capture ANY uncaught error during init (jsdom routes listener exceptions to jsdomError).\n  // A crash on load must FAIL the check — it can no longer hide behind other passing assertions (RI-0008).\n  const loadErrors = [];\n  const vc = new VirtualConsole();\n  vc.on('jsdomError', e => loadErrors.push((e && e.message) || String(e)));\n  const dom = new JSDOM(html, { runScripts: 'outside-only', pretendToBeVisual: true,\n    url: 'http://localhost/frontend/pages/' + rel, virtualConsole: vc });\n  const w = dom.window;\n  w.matchMedia = w.matchMedia || function () { return { matches: false, addListener() {}, removeListener() {}, addEventListener() {}, removeEventListener() {} }; };\n  w.print = w.print || function () {};\n  w.eval(JS);   // registers a DOMContentLoaded listener (jsdom stays in 'loading')\n  w.document.dispatchEvent(new w.Event('DOMContentLoaded', { bubbles: true }));  // fire init()\n  w.__loadErrors = loadErrors;\n  ok(rel + ': loads with NO uncaught error (init did not crash)', loadErrors.length === 0);\n  return w;\n}\nfunction click(w, el) { el.dispatchEvent(new w.window.Event('click', { bubbles: true, cancelable: true })); No inline scripts, no page-specific JS. All behavior lives in search.js.\n66\t\n67\t**FE-I3 Standard nav.** Nav must contain in order: `.logo` link → `.idx` dropdown (all 20 groups) → `.nav-search` with `id=\"si\"` + `id=\"cnt\"` → `.nav-r` with ✎ and ? icons. No additional nav elements without corespine update.\n68\t\n69\t**FE-I4 Breadcrumb row.** Every page must have `.bc` div containing `bc-arr` back + forward buttons followed by the breadcrumb trail. Placed immediately after `</nav>`.\n70\t\n71\t**FE-I5 Design-system tokens only.** No hardcoded hex/rgb color values outside `:root` in style.css. All visual decisions flow through `--bg`, `--nav`, `--border`, `--text`, `--muted`, `--accent`, `--hover`.\n72\t\n73\t**FE-I6 Responsive layout.** All layouts use CSS Grid or Flexbox. No fixed-width containers. Minimum supported viewport: 320px. No horizontal overflow. Tested breakpoints: 320px, 768px, 1200px.\n74\t\n75\t**FE-I7 Cell / mobile.** Nav must remain functional and non-overflowing at 320px. Touch targets ≥ 44×44px for primary interactive elements (nav links, buttons, `.fi a`). Dropdown must not break on small viewports.\n76\t\n77\t**FE-I8 Dead-link-free.** Every `href=\"../../...\"` relative link must resolve on disk before commit. Verified by `bash frontend/rebuild.sh`. This scans the governed tree and flags any\n# file missing a `tags:` line OR a `Status:` line. WARN-only now (SWIFT-safe); the BLOCK form is\n# ARCH-00407 Phase 0. Vocabulary-VALIDITY (status ∈ the right enum) is a follow-on — statuses are\n# context-scoped across multiple enums (node/planning/archive/root-insights), reconciliation pending.\n# Usage: bash dna/checks/creation-gate.sh   (exit 0 always — WARN; findings printed for [ZF]/RQC).\nrepo=\"$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || echo .)\"; cd \"$repo\" 2>/dev/null || exit 0\n\necho \"[CREATION-GATE] every governed file must carry a tag AND a status (mandatory minimum; WARN — ARCH-00407 Phase 0 is the BLOCK):\"\nmissing=0\n# Governed dirs where every .md is a governed artifact (READMEs + templates + index/manifest stubs are exempt).\nfor f in $(git ls-files 'dna/corespines/**/*.md' 'dna/protocols/**/*.md' 'dna/planning/**/*.md' \\\n                        'dna/schema/**/*.md' 'dna/vocabulary/**/*.md' '.claude/agents/*.md' '.claude/skills/**/*.md' 2>/dev/null); do\n  base=\"$(basename \"$f\")\"\n  # Exemptions (declared, not silent): READMEs, templates (own PLACEHOLDER convention), split-index stubs.\n  case \"$base\" in README.md|*-template.md|*-index.md|BUILD-PROMPT-template.md) continue;; esac\n  case \"$f\" in *dna/templates/*) continue;; esac\n  # Presence check (mandatory minimum): a governed file must declare a tags: and a Status: SOMEWHERE\n  # (frontmatter `tags:`, bold `**Status:**`, mid-line `| Status:`, or a deeper governance header all count).\n  # Whole-file, case-insensitive — WARN gate, so the tiny body-prose false-positive risk is acceptable.\n  has_tag=\"$(grep -ciE 'tags:' \"$f\" 2>/dev/null)\"\n  has_status=\"$(grep -ciE 'status:' \"$f\" 2>/dev/null)\"\n  if [ \"${has_tag:-0}\" -eq 0 ] || [ \"${has_status:-0}\" -eq 0 ]; then\n    miss=\"\"\n    [ \"${has_tag:-0}\" -eq 0 ] && miss=\"no tag\"\n    [ \"${has_status:-0}\" -eq 0 ] && miss=\"${miss:+$miss + }no status\"\n    echo \"   UNGOVERNED: $f ($miss)\"\n    missing=$((missing+1))\n  fi\ndone\nif [ \"$missing\" -eq 0 ]; then\n  echo \"   (none — every governed file carries a tag + a status)\"\nelse\n  echo \"   -> $missing governed file(s) born without tag/status. Subsumes ad-hoc corespine creation — all corespines go through this wizard from now on.\n16\t**Architecture note (ARCH-00396 Phase B, concern 2):** This node embeds its corespine-creation protocol INLINE as STEP 1–6 (lines 70–117). Exception: wizard-type node with mandated STEP 1–6 procedure + template blocks + YAML schema; structural content not reducible without losing executability.\n20\t\n21\t---\n22\t\n23\t## §I Gate Trace\n24\t\n25\t**§3.0 Tier:** Sonnet DRAFTS wizard, Opus ratifies on first use for each new corespine's §3.3 Pocket fields and truth-bearing declarations.\n26\t**§3.1 Goal:** Create corespines correctly, consistently, and at scale — zero ad-hoc creation.\n27\t**§3.2b Existing-First:** No corespine creation protocol exists (`dna/protocols/` searched). ARCH-00190 covers plans; ARCH-00340 covers meta-protocol; neither covers corespine-specific creation. New.\n28\t**§3.3 Pocket:** `reasoning_scope: corespine creation protocol` | `inherited_constraints: §3 gates, A2, A5, I10, I19, I22` | `output_contract: corespine directory + manifest + registry entries` | `ai_cannot: ratify its own output` | `cal_reference: ARCH-00390`\n29\t**§3.4 Standalone:** All refs resolve.\n30\t**§3.5 Naming:** CISEM-ARCH-00394, seq 394.\n31\t**§3.6 Size:** 250 lines — exception documented above.\n32\t**§3.7 Creation Triad:** ✓ gates | ✓ pocket | ✓ oversight (RQC on each corespine created)\n33\t\n34\t---\n35\t\n36\t## §II YAML Input Schema\n37\t\n38\tDefine one or more corespines in a single block. Feed to Sonnet for execution.\n39\t\n40\t```yaml\n41\t# corespine-batch.yaml — define N corespines; wizard generates all\n42\tcorespines:\n43\t\n44\t  - name: CS-EXAMPLE-001   # example-only — NOT-YET-A-NODE\n45\t    domain: \"short label (e.g. Frontend, Auth, Data)\"\n46\t    goal: \"one-sentence governing goal\"\n47\t    scope: \"what artifacts / concerns it governs\"\n48\t    parent: \"CS-CREATION-001 or other parent corespine\"\n49\t    depth: \"L1 / L2 / L3\"\n50\t    initial_status: \"DECLARED / PROPOSED / PLACEHOLDER\"\n51\t    governed_artifacts:\n52\t      - type: \"file type or artifact class\"\n53\t        location: \"path/in/repo/\"\n54\t    invariants:\n55\t      - id: \"XX-I1\"\n56\t        rule: \"bright-line rule text\"\n57\t      # add more as needed\n58\t    content_files:\n59\t      - arch_seq: \"assigned from naming-registry.yaml\"\n60\t        slug: \"kebab-case-descriptor\"\n61\t        type: \"MANIFEST / DESIGN-SYSTEM / PROTOCOL / TEMPLATE\"\n62\t        purpose: \"one-line purpose\"\n63\t    mirrors:\n64\t      - source: \"where truth lives\"\n65\t        mirror: \"where a pointer/copy exists\"\n66\t        rule: \"divergence rule\"\n67\t```\n68\t\n69\t---\n70\t\n71\t## §III Execution — STEP 0–6 (Sonnet runs, Opus reviews §3.3 fields)\n72\t\n73\t### STEP 0 — GOAL-SETTING (MANDATORY, FIRST — Governor decree 2026-07-20; threshold GATE 0)\n74\t\n75\t**A corespine MUST begin by setting and SAVING its goal — this is prior to everything else.** The `goal:` YAML field is the OUTPUT of this step, never an assumption fed in. The SAME goal is mandatory for CoreSpiral development too — goal-setting is the **shared root** of both CoreSpine (inheritance) and CoreSpiral (development), not a step inside either (FOUND-00001 CoreSpiral; CLAUDE.md §2.7 GATE 0).\n76\t\n77\tRun the goal-setting DIALOGUE before touching STEP 1:\n78\t1. **Ask the human to describe, in their own words, what this corespine is for** — do not draft the goal for them first.\n79\t2. **Shape it to the Goal ground rules:** a goal is a **TARGET** (not the \"why\"); state the **DO** (positive desired outcome) first, then close with the **DON'T** (the opposite polarity). \"Passes the gates\" is a MEANS, never the goal.\n80\t3. **Check it SERVES the north star** (FOUND-00001 apex) — every sub-goal inherits from and must serve the platform goal.\n81\t4. **SAVE the defined goal** into the corespine's `goal:` field (STEP 4 registry + manifest §II) and stamp the input `goal-connected`.\n82\t- Goal absent or not agreed → STAY here (loop the dialogue); Create `dna/corespines/{CS-NAME}/CISEM-ARCH-{SEQ}-{domain}-corespine-manifest.md` from the MANIFEST TEMPLATE (§IV below).\n108\t3. Populate all fields from the YAML input. this registry is\n# CONCEPT-scoped — one durable entry per found-wrong→improved ROOT INSIGHT (the class, not the local fix).\n#\n# RIPL, in one line: on every found-wrong→improved event, EXTRACT the root-core insight (the CLASS) →\n# ROUTE it (Axiom / Planning / Creation / Behavior / Persona / check) → WIRE-or-PARK → RECORD here.\n# Never fix locally without extracting the class, or the gap repeats elsewhere under a different name.\n#\n# Field contract per entry (RI-NNNN):\n#   date          — when the insight was extracted\n#   trigger       — the found-wrong event that surfaced it\n#   root_insight  — the CLASS-level lesson (not the point-fix)\n#   routes_to     — where the insight was/will be routed (axiom / check / plan / park, named)\n#   status        — WIRED | PARTLY-WIRED | PARKED | PROPOSED (truth-bearing; only Opus stamps WIRED, I7)\n#\n# Append-only, like session-learning-index.yaml and quality-ledger.yaml — do not rewrite prior entries;\n# a later entry may SUPERSEDE an earlier one by reference, never by silent edit.\n#\n# ═══ SSOT DECLARATION (Governor decree 2026-07-20) — the ONE schema-aligned home for LEARNING-LOOP OUTCOMES ═══\n# This file is the SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the OUTCOMES of every CISEM learning loop — the class-level\n# PREVENTIONS/root-insights the loops produce (RIPL, RQC, session-harvest, agent-profiling, page-functional).\n# Schema position: T-SYS, learning-loop layer. Registered in dna/ssot-registry.yaml as `learning_outcomes`.\n# Field contract (RI-NNNN): date · trigger · root_insight (the CLASS) · routes_to (all surfaces it wires into) · status.\n# Relationship to the sibling stores (each has ONE crisp role, A9 — they FEED outcomes here, they are not second homes):\n#   - dna/governor-insights.yaml (GI-NNNN)          = INDEX of Governor DECREES (points to each decree's home).\n#   - dna/learning-registry/session-learning-index.yaml = per-SESSION log (raw capture; its distilled CLASSES land here).\n#   - dna/quality-ledger.yaml (run N)               = per-run METRICS + verdicts (its recurring findings distill to RI here).\n#   - dna/corespines/CS-AI-PROFILING-001/agent-profiles.yaml = per-AGENT improvements (cross-enrichment; class-level ones route here).\n# RULE: any learning loop's OUTCOME (a prevention/class-lesson) is not \"captured\" until it has an RI-NNNN entry here\n# with routes_to naming EVERY surface it wires into (Principle 17 PREVENTION-MUST-PROPAGATE). This is the closest\n# schema-aligned consolidation of learning outcomes; the RIPL weekly batch (ARCH-00406) promotes mature RIs to wired guards.\n\ninsights:\n  RI-0001:\n    date: \"2026-07-20\"\n    trigger: \"A9 orthogonal-facets guardrail found flawed by 8-persona stress-panel\"\n    root_insight: >\n      An ASSERTED global-consistency claim over open-ended prose is undecidable and violates\n      I22/I23 (assertion-over-verification). Rule: check consistency inside a fixed DECIDABLE\n      language, else label it ASSERTED (refutation-testable, never \"verified\").\n    routes_to:\n      - \"A9 guardrail (WIRED 2026-07-20)\"\n      - \"candidate general principle: assert-vs-decide honesty → propose as invariant\"\n      - \"PAE + creation checks (park)\"\n    status: PARTLY-WIRED\n  RI-0002:\n    date: \"2026-07-20\"\n    trigger: \"Haiku+Sonnet cross-review of compaction-prep — each caught the other's blind spot; even the 'correct' reviewer (Sonnet) had a wrong denominator (4/15 vs actual 4/14)\"\n    root_insight: \"A single model errs even when REVIEWING. Anything governing HOW agents work (a checklist / an agent's essence) needs TWO-MODEL verification via two ORTHOGONAL lenses (protocol-compliance x content-correctness); an agent-SELF change also needs Opus ratification. Every flag must be classified NEW-DRIFT vs ALREADY-RESOLVED against current state, or the reviewer manufactures false positives (re-digging resolved holes).\"\n    routes_to: [\"persona DEVELOPMENT DISCIPLINE (agent-change governance + two-lens — WIRED behaviorally)\", \"BP-0010 (two-model-verify activation list + tab prompts)\", \"BP-0009 (mechanical /cisem-precompact-verify skill — PARKED)\"]\n    status: PARTLY-WIRED\n  RI-0003:\n    date: \"2026-07-20\"\n    trigger: \"Governor caught 'ZF green' reported as a full-board pass when it was only the 9-invariant ZF subset; 10+ WARN findings ([RAW-PAIR] depollution backlog) stood the whole time; no loop-until-dry convergence was run\"\n    root_insight: \"SUBSET-PASS-AS-FULL-PASS (plausibility-over-verification): reporting a partial gate as if complete. Rule: report the FULL check board, never a subset-pass as a full-pass; drive WARN findings to zero or EXPLICITLY route each; 'green' = the whole board is green, stated honestly.\"\n    routes_to: [\"CLAUDE.md §2 Principle 17 HONEST-REPORTING sub-rule (WIRED behaviorally)\", \"candidate mechanical: plan-audit prints a FULL-BOARD finding COUNT line above [ZF]\"]\n    status: PARTLY-WIRED\n  RI-0004:\n    date: \"2026-07-20\"\n    trigger: \"Governor caught Opus's own hands-on edits running WITHOUT an inline Pocket Declaration and SELF-REVIEWED (no independent lower-tier verification) — 2 of 3 Creation-Triad legs weak on the judge's own actions\"\n    root_insight: \"OPUS-FREESTYLE-INSIDE-THE-FRAME: shell/gates honored but the pocket + independent-oversight legs skipped on Opus's own edits. Rule: for HTML pages present browser-openable links (launch the browser / full file:// URL), verified by code before presenting.\"\n    routes_to: [\"presentation habit (behavioral)\", \"GI-53\"]\n    status: WIRED\n  RI-0006:\n    date: \"2026-07-20\"\n    trigger: \"Opus created dna/root-insights.yaml duplicating the existing dna/learning-registry/root-insights.yaml (A8/I19 SSOT fork) — checked ONE guessed path (ls dna/root-insights.yaml) not the basename across the repo; caught by the ARCH-00406 soundness review\"\n    root_insight: \"CREATE-AFTER-SINGLE-PATH-CHECK: Existing-First that checks one guessed path misses a same-named home in another dir. Rule: before creating ANY file, `find -name <basename>` across the whole repo (not a single ls); a same-basename registry elsewhere = a fork to consolidate into, never a second home.\"\n    routes_to: [\"candidate mechanical: [DUPLICATE-BASENAME] check in plan-audit\", \"§3.2b Existing-First strengthening (basename-grep step)\"]\n    status: PARKED\n  RI-0007:\n    date: \"2026-07-20\"\n    trigger: \"Governor found the schema-page '-' collapse doesn't work, AFTER Opus reported it 'verified by code' — because the verification checked LISTENER PRESENCE (19/19 wired), not BEHAVIOR. One of THREE standing\n# anti-deletion preventions: (1) this diff-guard; (2) the frontend element-inventory regression in\n# functional-check.mjs (a page may never lose elements); (3) REVERT-NOT-REPAIR + atomic scoped commits\n# (CLAUDE.md Principle 18). WARN-only (not in ZF); pairs with §1.7 \"stage specific files, never git add -A\".\nrepo=\"$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || echo .)\"; cd \"$repo\" 2>/dev/null || exit 0\nTHRESHOLD=\"${CISEM_DELETION_THRESHOLD:-25}\"   # net lines removed in one file that trips the guard\n\necho \"[DELETION-GUARD] files with a large NET line loss vs HEAD (possible collateral deletion — verify intended; WARN):\"\nfound=0\n# numstat: added \\t deleted \\t file  (working tree vs HEAD, tracked files)\nwhile IFS=$'\\t' read -r add del file; do\n  [ -z \"$file\" ] && continue\n  case \"$add$del\" in *-*) continue;; It may NEVER happen. Enforced by THREE mechanisms, not one: **(1)** `dna/checks/deletion-guard.sh`\n    (wired into plan-audit) flags any file with a large NET line loss vs HEAD — a silent deletion is surfaced before\n    commit and must be justified or reverted; **(2)** the frontend **element-inventory regression** in\n    `functional-check.mjs` — a page may never lose interactive elements (a drop FAILS the check); **(3)** **REVERT-NOT-REPAIR\n    + atomic scoped commits** — when an edit breaks or leaves unverified/broken state, REVERT to last-verified-good rather\n    than patch forward (as done with the crashed agent); stage SPECIFIC files (§1.7), one concern per commit, so any bad\n    change is isolated and revertible. **Always verify the WHOLE after touching a part** (enumerate-all check), never just\n    the element you touched.\n    **(B) GLOBAL-VIEW, NOT NARROW-SCOPE — 2 permanent ways.** \"One narrow scope at a time\" is the OPPOSITE of CISEM's job.\n    **(1) UNIVERSAL-BY-DEFAULT:** every mechanical check ENUMERATES its whole class by construction (`find`/readdir all,\n    not a curated sample or one file-type) — a gate declared for \"everything\" (A5) must fire on everything, not the first\n    scope it started in (this is exactly what let 22 files be born ungoverned and the toggle die on unaudited pages).\n    **(2) CLASS-COMPLETENESS:** when you build or fix anything, ask \"what is the CLASS, and does the mechanism cover ALL of\n    it?\" — and STATE the coverage. A fix that covers one instance is incomplete until the class is covered (ties Principle 17\n    DEFECT→CLASS-AUDIT). Prefer widening an existing universal gate over adding another narrow one.\n    **(C) WIRE, DON'T DOCUMENT — end plausibility-completion for all models.** A thing is \"hardwired / wired / enforced /\n    done\" ONLY if a RUNNING mechanism proves it (a check/hook/test + its output). Writing ABOUT a mechanism is NOT building\n    it (documentation-as-progress). Any such claim MUST cite the mechanism (file + how it runs); an unproven claim is stated\n    **NOT-YET-WIRED:<reason>**. Mechanically backstopped by `[I23]` (activation claims without a mechanism on disk) — extend,\n    never weaken it. **MANDATORY PREVENTION (reinforces Principle 17):** you may not report an error/gap/problem WITHOUT\n    stating its class-level PREVENTION on the same turn.
