{"parentUuid":"a7f4b304-c863-4368-ac8b-4cb8cf8f32b2","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"396f8196-ce9b-4917-81d3-5a2a6f055356","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"type":"document","source":{"type":"text","media_type":"text/plain","data":"# Creation Core Spine â Appendix A: Formal Review, Six Expert Perspectives\n**Parent:** `CISEM_Creation_Core_Spine_ROOT.md` (file 4 of 5 in this minitree â see root for scope, TOC, master revision log, and Open Items)\n**File-local revision note:** carried forward unchanged from Rev 11 of the single-file draft. This file was already self-contained enough to split cleanly with no rewording needed.\n\n---\n\n**Purpose:** structured critique of the document as it stood at Rev 10 (pre-split, single-file version), run before further depth was added, per the standard of verifying completeness at the current layer before advancing (5.2). Presented to the Governor for onward transmission to CISEM Core for comment.\n\n## 1. Systems / Software Architect\n**Point:** the macro/sub-status split (Rev 10) has no transition table â nothing defines which sub-status change triggers which macro promotion.\n**Critique:** two actors could independently set a terminal sub-status (e.g. `GOAL-CONFIRMED`) and never promote the macro status, letting the two coordinates drift out of sync undetected.\n**Recommendation:** add an explicit sub-status â macro-status transition table, and consider making macro status a *derived* field computed from sub-status rather than two separately maintained values â one source of truth. *(Root Open Item #8.)*\n\n## 2. Governance / Risk Officer\n**Point:** Blast Risk already gates a ratification decision (the corespine \"Blast Risk floor\") while its own scale/threshold remains `[M]` Missing.\n**Critique:** enforcing a decision on an undefined metric is a governance gap in itself â a sequencing problem, not a content problem.\n**Recommendation:** resolve Blast Risk's scale before any further logic is built to depend on it. *(Root Open Item #4.)*\n\n## 3. Cognitive / UX Expert (human-AI interaction)\n**Point:** Step 2 alone stacks 6 checklist items, the Early Corespine Hypothesis, and (per the Research section) a research-need question, all serially.\n**Critique:** this collides with the Governor's own cognitive-load standard (4.6) â too much compressed into one interaction point, even though each individual question is independently justified.\n**Recommendation:** batch Step 2 into 2â3 grouped exchanges rather than one long serial interrogation; make explicit that `COREGUESS:UNSET` is a fully neutral answer, not a failure to perform. *(Flagged in trunk file for Steps 0â2.)*\n\n## 4. Technical Writer / Information Architect\n**Point:** cross-references were scattered across Steps 0, 2, 3, 4, and the Corespine Gate with no table of contents and no single consolidated state-map.\n**Critique:** fails the \"usable, not just readable\" standard (5.3) â a reader had to mentally assemble the full state machine from six separate locations.\n**Recommendation:** add a table of contents plus one consolidated appendix mapping every macro status Ã valid sub-status Ã owning step. **Resolved by this minitree split** â see root file's Cross-Reference Index / TOC.\n\n## 5. DevOps / Platform Engineer\n**Point:** the schema is genuinely complex (5 tag families, 2-coordinate status, per-step sub-status tables) with no stated enforcement mechanism.\n**Critique:** this collides directly with an already-open, unresolved CISEM item â CI/CD-style mechanical enforcement vs. AI-enforced convention vs. documentation convention was never formally declared. Adding schema depth on top of an undeclared enforcement level risks an elaborate paper process with no mechanical check, violating the Zero Findings Standard (no self-certification).\n**Recommendation:** decide enforcement level before adding further schema richness. Flagged as the most load-bearing unresolved item of the six â still open, the minitree split does not resolve this one.\n\n## 6. Organizational / Change Management Expert\n**Point:** every input â trivial or structural â currently runs the full 4-step gate, checklist, research pass, and (if landing in D) the corespine test.\n**Critique:** no triviality exception is defined. Proportional Gate Strength scales rigor *within* B/C/D, but not whether the full pipeline applies at all.\n**Recommendation:** confirm explicitly whether every input, including a one-line fix, is meant to run the full pipeline, or whether a lightweight fast-lane is intended and simply not yet designed. *(Root Open Item #9.)*\n\n## Cross-Cutting Observation (not tied to one expert)\nThe document's depth accumulated (Rev 1 â 10) faster than its open items resolved (7 outstanding at time of review). This is itself an instance of the \"layered depth\" standard (5.2) being outrun â advancing to more elaborate stages before completeness is verified at the base. **Partially addressed** by the Rev 12 minitree split (structural legibility improved), but the underlying open-items backlog is unchanged in count (now 10, with the split itself adding one more).\n\n**Status:** pending CISEM Core comment, transmitted by the Governor.\n\n---\n*End of minitree. Return to `CISEM_Creation_Core_Spine_ROOT.md` for the master index.*\n"},"title":"FROM CLAUDE AI BRAIN CISEM_Creation_Core_Spine_AppendixA-Review.md"},{"type":"document","source":{"type":"text","media_type":"text/plain","data":"# Creation Core Spine â Trunk: Step 4 + Corespine Determination Gate\n**Parent:** `CISEM_Creation_Core_Spine_ROOT.md` (file 3 of 5 in this minitree â see root for scope, TOC, master revision log, and Open Items)\n**Preceded by:** `CISEM_Creation_Core_Spine_TRUNK-Step3-Research.md`\n**File-local revision note:** split out of the single-file draft at Rev 12, content carried forward unchanged from Rev 1, 5, 6, and 9 as it applied to Step 4, Blast Risk, and the Corespine Determination Gate.\n\n---\n\n## Step 4 â Fork (Non-Exclusive Conditions)\n\nConditions are **not mutually exclusive** except where noted. Multiple conditions can hold simultaneously and combine into a single composite resolution path.\n\n| Condition | Description | Combinable? |\n|---|---|---|\n| **A â Already Exists, Operational** | Goal is already met by a live CISEM element | No â terminal if true alone |\n| **B â Enhancement** | Existing element needs modification/enhancement | Yes |\n| **C â Wiring/Bundling** | Existing elements need new connection or combination, no new artifact | Yes |\n| **D â New Element Required** | Existing elements are insufficient; new creation or import needed | Yes |\n| **E â Out of Scope** | Requirement falls entirely outside CISEM's defined domain | No â terminal if true alone |\n\n### Step 4 Sub-Status Set (draft, non-final)\n\n| Sub-Status | Meaning |\n|---|---|\n| `FORK-CANDIDATE` | One or more conditions (AâE) provisionally suspected, not yet confirmed |\n| `FORK-CONFIRMED-SINGLE` | Exactly one condition confirmed and it is terminal (A or E) |\n| `FORK-CONFIRMED-COMPOSITE` | Two or more of B/C/D confirmed together as the resolution path |\n| `FORK-PARKED` | Resolves to E and Governor has chosen to park rather than reject (pending root Open Item #2) |\n| `FORK-REJECTED` | Resolves to E and Governor has chosen outright rejection |\n| `FORK-ESCALATED` | Resolves to E and Governor has chosen schema-expansion escalation |\n\n### A â Already Exists, Operational\n- **Unique parameter: Awareness Gap.** The defining variable here isn't whether the solution exists â it's whether the requester *knows* it exists. This condition's primary output is not a build action but a **disclosure action**: surfacing the existing element to the human/AI that raised the input.\n- **Terminal by definition:** if A is true, nothing is built. The path closes with a pointer to the existing element, not a fork continuation.\n- `[M]` Missing: no defined format yet for how this disclosure is delivered (root Open Item #3).\n\n### B â Enhancement\n- **Unique parameter: Modification Surface.** What specifically must change on the existing element â its logic, its schema position, its wiring to other elements, or its content â without altering its identity or role in the corespine tree.\n- **Unique parameter: Blast Risk (see below)** â enhancement is the condition most directly gated by Blast Risk, since it alters something already live and depended upon.\n- Combinable with C and/or D: an enhancement may require new wiring to expose the enhanced capability, or a small new element to support it.\n\n### C â Wiring/Bundling\n- **Unique parameter: Connection Topology.** No new artifact is created; the fork resolves by defining new or changed *relationships* between existing elements â new inheritance links, new pipeline steps, or new bundling of previously separate elements into a combined capability.\n- **Unique parameter: No content mutation** â distinguishes C from B. Under C, the existing elements themselves are not changed; only their connections are.\n- Combinable with B and/or D: wiring may expose an enhanced element, or connect toward a newly created one.\n\n### D â New Element Required\n- **Unique parameter: Import vs. Create.** This condition forks further internally: is the new element built natively in CISEM, or imported from external/unratified material (e.g., Gemini output, other platforms) and then stripped and re-derived per the source-stripping principle?\n- **Unique parameter: Schema Slot Assignment.** Before build, the new element must be assigned a place in the existing schema (corespine, pipeline, or Gate) â it cannot be created \"floating\" and slotted in after the fact.\n- Highest default Blast Risk exposure among B/C/D, since it introduces something that did not previously exist in the dependency graph.\n\n### E â Out of Scope\n- **Unique parameter: Terminal Action â still undecided.** Unlike A, which terminates cleanly with disclosure, E's terminal action is unresolved: reject outright, park per Golden Insights (4.4), or escalate as a schema-expansion candidate for the Governor to rule on.\n- **`[M]` Missing â requires Governor decision (root Open Item #2) before this condition is operationally complete.**\n\n---\n\n## Blast Risk â Definition (Cross-Cutting to Step 4)\n\n**Blast Risk:** the potential significance of the ripple effect a proposed change or creation causes across related elements, and increasingly distant upstream/downstream elements, in the CISEM schema.\n\n- Governs the rigor applied to whichever combination of B/C/D is selected â inherits the existing **Proportional Gate Strength** principle rather than introducing a parallel concept.\n- **`[M]` Missing:** no defined scale or threshold yet (e.g., low/medium/high vs. a scored model). Required before Step 4 can be operationally gated rather than only conceptually named (root Open Item #4).\n\n---\n\n## Corespine Determination Gate â \"Royalty\" Handling\n\n**`[C]` Confirmed placement:** the formal corespine question is addressed **at Fork D**, and only at Fork D for new-creation purposes â never earlier. Steps 0â3 don't have enough confirmed evidence (goal, mapping) to test the five criteria properly; testing earlier would be premature classification, the same failure mode the anti-fabrication rules exist to prevent. The Early Corespine Hypothesis (Step 2, see prior file) is explicitly the *speculative* counterpart to this â bounded, non-binding, and superseded entirely once this gate runs.\n\n**Why Fork D specifically:** D is the only condition where something genuinely new enters the dependency graph. This is the exact moment structural weight must be tested â **before** Schema Slot Assignment, not after. A corespine is not slotted like a regular element; it is tested first, and the test result determines the slotting path, not the reverse.\n\n**Mechanism at this gate:**\n1. Run the existing **five-criteria test** (from the Corespine Creation Wizard). Criterion 3 (independent goal) has empirically been the discriminating test in every prior run â treat it as the first check, not the last, for efficiency.\n2. If the candidate passes as a corespine: **Schema Slot Assignment is replaced**, not supplemented, by the corespine-specific creation path (its own root file, discipline trunk, sub-files, implementation files â per the pattern already established for CS-COMMUNICATION-001, and now for this very document via the minitree split).\n3. If the candidate fails: it proceeds as a regular new element under standard Schema Slot Assignment, as already defined under Fork D.\n\n**Reach-back rule â B and C are not exempt:** if the element being enhanced (B) or rewired (C) **already is** a corespine, that status is inherited automatically into the fork, regardless of which condition (B/C/D) triggered the cycle. A corespine does not become an ordinary element just because this particular change looks like an enhancement or a wiring job. This must be checked explicitly at the start of B or C handling, not assumed absent.\n\n**Royalty treatment â what elevated status actually means operationally:**\n- **Ratification tier:** corespine-track decisions require the Governor's explicit sign-off â not standard Step 1 consensus alone. Consistent with sole ratification authority already established for corespine-level structural decisions.\n- **Blast Risk floor:** any cycle touching a confirmed or newly-created corespine is treated as **elevated Blast Risk by default**, regardless of how small the change looks in isolation â corespines sit higher in the dependency graph, so ripple potential is structurally greater even for minor edits.\n- **No shortcut path:** the fast-path collapse question (already open elsewhere, re: already-ratified Protocols) does **not** apply to corespines. Every corespine-track cycle runs the full gate, every time.\n\n### Corespine Determination Gate Sub-Status Set (draft, non-final)\n\n| Sub-Status | Meaning |\n|---|---|\n| `FIVE-CRITERIA-PENDING` | Fork D confirmed, corespine test not yet run |\n| `FIVE-CRITERIA-RUNNING` | Test in progress, criterion 3 (independent goal) checked first |\n| `COREGUESS-CONFIRMED` | Formal result matches the Step 2 speculative guess |\n| `COREGUESS-OVERTURNED` | Formal result contradicts the Step 2 speculative guess â logged for the calibration question (root Open Item #6) |\n| `COREGUESS-REJECTED` | Test fails â candidate proceeds as a regular element under standard Schema Slot Assignment |\n| `ROYALTY-CONFIRMED` | Test passes â corespine-specific creation path begins; regular slot assignment is bypassed |\n| `ROYALTY-ESCALATED-B` / `ROYALTY-ESCALATED-C` | Reach-back rule triggered: the element touched under Enhancement or Wiring/Bundling was already a confirmed corespine |\n| `ROYALTY-RATIFICATION-PENDING` | Corespine-track cycle awaiting Governor's explicit sign-off before proceeding |\n\n---\n*End of file. Continue to `CISEM_Creation_Core_Spine_AppendixA-Review.md` for the six-expert review.*\n"},"title":"FROM CLAUDE AI BRAIN CISEM_Creation_Core_Spine_TRUNK-Step4-CorespineGate.md"},{"type":"document","source":{"type":"text","media_type":"text/plain","data":"# Creation Core Spine â Trunk: Step 3 + Research\n**Parent:** `CISEM_Creation_Core_Spine_ROOT.md` (file 2 of 5 in this minitree â see root for scope, TOC, master revision log, and Open Items)\n**Preceded by:** `CISEM_Creation_Core_Spine_TRUNK-Steps0-2.md`\n**File-local revision note:** split out of the single-file draft at Rev 12, content carried forward unchanged from Rev 1, 7, 8, and 10 as it applied to Step 3 and Research.\n\n---\n\n## Step 3 â Existing Landscape Mapping\n\nMap all CISEM elements potentially relevant to the defined goal. Present findings before any fork decision â mapping is evidence, not conclusion.\n\n**`[C]` This step *is* research by nature** â see the Research section below for how this obligation is enforced and where it extends (Step 2 checklist in the prior file, this step, and Fork D's Import vs. Create sub-fork in the next file). Asserting an element exists, or doesn't, without checking GitHub/Drive first is the exact fabrication risk Step 1 already prohibits.\n\n**Immediately following this step**, before the fork condition is locked in, the **Pre-Finalization Research Prompt** (below) runs once against the draft plan to catch anything the internal mapping alone would miss.\n\n### Step 3 Sub-Status Set (draft, non-final)\n\n| Sub-Status | Meaning |\n|---|---|\n| `MAPPING-IN-PROGRESS` | Landscape search underway (GitHub/Drive/registry cross-check) |\n| `MAPPING-CONFLICT-FLAGGED` | Registry entry and actual file existence disagree, or two sources conflict â surfaced, not silently reconciled |\n| `MAPPING-COMPLETE` | All relevant existing elements identified and presented |\n| `RESEARCH-PASS-PENDING` | Mapping complete, Pre-Finalization Research Prompt not yet run |\n| `RESEARCH-PASS-COMPLETE-NO-FINDINGS` | Research run, nothing material found â logged per the auditability rule below |\n| `RESEARCH-PASS-COMPLETE-FINDINGS-INTEGRATED` | Research surfaced something and the draft plan was updated accordingly |\n\n---\n\n## Research â Where It Lives in This Flow\n\n**`[C]` Confirmed posture:** research is not a standalone step. A standalone \"Research Step\" would float outside the schema â a new place with no defined role or connection, violating the \"nothing floats\" rule. Instead, research is a **capability invoked at existing gates**, wherever certainty would otherwise be asserted without verification.\n\n**Three points where research is invoked:**\n\n1. **Step 2 checklist** (previous file) â an explicit checklist item: *\"Is there uncertainty here that requires research before this goal can be confirmed rather than assumed?\"* This is the \"some research will be helpful\" moment, made mandatory rather than optional.\n2. **Step 3 (this file, Existing Landscape Mapping)** â this step *is* research by nature. Research is the mechanism this step requires, not an addition to it.\n3. **Fork D (next file), Import vs. Create sub-fork** â before importing external material, research confirms what is actually being imported, per the existing rule that Gemini/other-platform output is unratified raw suggestion material.\n\n### Pre-Finalization Research Prompt (Draft Plan Stage)\n\nOnce a draft plan exists (goal defined, landscape mapped, fork condition(s) assigned), and **before** the plan is presented for ratification, run one research pass using a prompt of this shape:\n\n> *\"Given this draft plan for [goal/element], search for: (1) whether this problem has a known solution pattern already documented elsewhere, (2) whether there are existing frameworks, standards, or approaches that would meaningfully change this plan if known, (3) whether there are recent developments, warnings, or failure reports related to this specific approach that we should factor in before finalizing. Report only what would change or strengthen the plan â do not report generic background.\"*\n\n- **`[I]` Inferred rule:** if this research pass surfaces nothing that changes the plan, that is itself logged as a confirmed outcome (\"research run, no material findings\") â not skipped or omitted, so the check remains auditable.\n- **`[I]` Inferred placement:** this pass sits at the close of Step 3 / entry to Step 4, since it needs the goal and landscape mapping to be meaningful, but must complete before the fork condition is locked in.\n- This is a recurring gate, not a one-time step â it re-runs at draft-plan stage for every creation cycle, not only for novel or unusual requests.\n\n---\n*End of file. Continue to `CISEM_Creation_Core_Spine_TRUNK-Step4-CorespineGate.md` for Step 4, Blast Risk, and the Corespine Determination Gate.*\n"},"title":"FROM CLAUDE AI BRAIN CISEM_Creation_Core_Spine_TRUNK-Step3-Research.md"},{"type":"document","source":{"type":"text","media_type":"text/plain","data":"# Creation Core Spine â Trunk: Steps 0â2\n**Parent:** `CISEM_Creation_Core_Spine_ROOT.md` (file 1 of 5 in this minitree â see root for scope, TOC, master revision log, and Open Items)\n**File-local revision note:** split out of the single-file draft at Rev 12, content carried forward unchanged from Rev 1â10 as it applied to Steps 0â2.\n\n---\n\n## Step 0 â Threshold / Intake\n\n**Input source:** human (request, wish, complaint, suggestion) or native AI (suggestion/request).\n\n**Action:** input crosses the threshold, receives an initial tag, status = `RAW`.\n\n**Rule â nothing proceeds past this point unformatted, untagged, or unstatused.**\n\n### Draft Tag List (initial, non-final)\n\n| Tag | Meaning |\n|---|---|\n| `SRC:HUMAN` | Origin is a human input |\n| `SRC:AI` | Origin is a native AI-generated suggestion |\n| `TYPE:REQUEST` | Explicit ask for something to be built/changed |\n| `TYPE:WISH` | Aspirational, not yet a formed request |\n| `TYPE:COMPLAINT` | Signals a defect or gap in what exists |\n| `TYPE:SUGGESTION` | Proposed improvement, not urgent |\n| `PRIORITY:UNSET` | Default until triaged |\n| `BLAST:UNSET` | Blast Risk not yet assessed (see file 4 â Step 4) |\n| `COREGUESS:<name>` / `COREGUESS:UNSET` | Speculative early corespine hypothesis from Step 2 â never authoritative, see subsection below |\n\n### Draft Status List (initial, non-final â this is the MACRO status set)\n\n| Status | Meaning |\n|---|---|\n| `RAW` | Just entered threshold, unprocessed |\n| `IN-PROCESS` | Verification/understanding underway |\n| `VERIFIED` | Understanding confirmed â Step 1 gate passed |\n| `GOAL-DEFINED` | Step 2 mentor-stage output complete |\n| `MAPPED` | Step 3 existing-landscape mapping complete (see file 3) |\n| `FORKED` | Step 4 condition(s) assigned (see file 4) |\n| `PARKED` | Deferred per Golden Insights rule â not lost, not active |\n| `REJECTED` | Determined out of scope, terminated with reasoning recorded |\n| `ACTIVE-BUILD` | Moved to implementation |\n\n**`[C]` Confirmed instruction:** Both the tag list and the status list above are **drafts, not final or closed sets**. Tags in particular are expected to be **added and removed as the process evolves** â this list is a living registry, not a fixed enumeration. Any addition or removal must itself be logged (what changed, why), consistent with the \"Changes Must Be Visible\" standard. Status values are more structurally load-bearing than tags (they drive gate logic), so changes to the status set carry a higher ratification bar than changes to the tag set â this distinction is `[I]` inferred from how gates depend on status vs. tags, and should be explicitly confirmed or corrected by the Governor (see root, Open Item #5).\n\n**`[I]` Status hierarchy â macro vs. sub-status:** the list above is the **macro status**. It does not tell you *where within a step* things stand â each step (this file and files 3, 4) carries its own **sub-status set** for finer-grained state. An input carries two coordinates at any time: one macro status (this table) and one sub-status (from the relevant step's own table). This split is `[I]` inferred as the right structure, not yet Governor-confirmed.\n\n---\n\n## Step 1 â Verified Understanding (Universal Mandatory Gate)\n\n**`[C]` This content must appear in all three layers: the Protocol, the Wizard, and the Spine itself** â not as duplicated logic in each, but as the same referenced gate invoked from all three. This is a cross-cutting obligation, not a local rule owned by one layer.\n\n**Why this step is not trivial:** this is the single most repeated root cause of drift across CISEM sessions to date. Skipping or rushing it has produced more downstream rework than any other failure mode observed so far.\n\n**Governing posture for this step:** the exchange between human and AI (or AI and AI) at this gate is conducted as an **amicable process of mutual respect and humility** â not an interrogation, and not a rubber stamp. Both sides are trying to arrive at the same true understanding together.\n\n**Mechanism:** this gate does not invent its own verification method. It inherits and invokes the existing **Reflect-Until-Match** protocol (CS-COMM-INTENT-CRYSTALLIZATION-001) and the per-message **WHO/WARRANT/ACTION** discipline trunk from CS-COMMUNICATION-001. This step is a gate that *calls* that mechanism, not a re-derivation of it.\n\n### Step 1 Sub-Status Set (draft, non-final)\n\n| Sub-Status | Meaning |\n|---|---|\n| `UNDERSTANDING-DRAFTED` | AI has produced a first restatement of the input, not yet reviewed by the source |\n| `UNDERSTANDING-DISPUTED` | Source has flagged the restatement as inaccurate or incomplete â Reflect-Until-Match re-runs |\n| `UNDERSTANDING-PARTIAL` | Some elements confirmed, others still open â used when input has multiple distinct parts |\n| `UNDERSTANDING-CONFIRMED` | Full consensus reached â this is what promotes macro status to `VERIFIED` |\n\n### AI Behavior Considerations at This Gate\n\n**What to avoid:**\n- Fabricating or guessing any structure, name, version, or detail not explicitly given.\n- False assumptions presented as understood fact.\n- Premature \"satisfaction points\" â declaring understanding confirmed before it actually is, to move the process along.\n- Silent reconciliation of conflicting inputs â conflicts must be surfaced, not smoothed over.\n- Leaving any question or piece of content without a response. **No open item is dropped or skipped.**\n\n**What to do instead:**\n- State explicitly what is confirmed, what is inferred, what is assumed, and what is missing â never blur these categories.\n- Where a gap exists, name it as a gap out loud rather than filling it with a plausible guess.\n- Allow and expect confrontation in favor of excellence â pushing back on a wrong or premature understanding is the job at this gate, not a violation of the \"amicable\" posture. Respectful and direct are not in tension.\n- Strive for actual consensus before advancing status to `VERIFIED` â not a one-sided declaration that understanding has been reached.\n\n---\n\n## Step 2 â Mentor-Stage: Deep Cause & Goal Definition\n\n**Opening principle for this step:** the process must be **frictionless without skipping any step**. Frictionless does not mean fast or shortcut â it means the human is never left guessing what's needed next. This is achieved by **always asking the human user directly** and working from their actual answers to gather all data and reasoning required, rather than inferring silently and hoping it's correct.\n\n**Required mechanism â a checklist.** Before this step can output a defined goal, a checklist must be worked through with the human (draft below, non-final, same living-registry logic as Step 0's tags applies):\n\n### Draft Mentor-Stage Checklist\n- [ ] What is the surface-level request, stated plainly back to the human for confirmation?\n- [ ] What underlying problem, need, or friction is producing this request? (asked directly, not inferred)\n- [ ] What would \"solved\" look like in concrete, observable terms?\n- [ ] Is this goal independent, or is it actually a symptom of a different, deeper goal?\n- [ ] Are there constraints (technical, timing, resource, dependency) the human hasn't stated but that shape the goal?\n- [ ] Has the human confirmed the goal statement as accurate, in their own words or by explicit agreement?\n- [ ] **Early Corespine Hypothesis (speculative):** *\"If we were to guess at this premature stage, to which corespine does this issue/goal belong? Which corespine would it be?\"* â see dedicated subsection below. This is asked but never answered as fact.\n\n**Mentor vibe:** CISEM's posture here is that of a mentor helping surface a goal that may not be fully clear even to the requester â not a form-filler extracting fields. The human \"sounding\" focused is explicitly not sufficient evidence they *are* focused; this step exists precisely to test that.\n\n**`[I]` Cognitive-load flag (per Appendix A, Expert 3):** this checklist plus the hypothesis below plus the research-need question (see file 3) all stack serially in one interaction. Recommendation on record: batch into 2â3 grouped exchanges rather than one long interrogation. Not yet implemented â flagging for Governor decision alongside root Open Items.\n\n### Early Corespine Hypothesis â Speculative, Non-Binding\n\n**The question, asked verbatim at this stage:** *\"If we were to guess in this premature stage, to which corespine does this issue/goal belong? Which corespine would it be?\"*\n\n**Why ask it this early, given the \"never guess\" rule:** this is not an exception to the anti-fabrication rule â it is a deliberately bounded, explicitly labeled guess, not a claim of fact. The distinction is: a guess that is named as a guess, tagged as such, and scheduled for formal re-testing is a hypothesis; a guess presented as understood is fabrication. This question produces the former, never the latter.\n\n**Purpose:**\n- Surfaces early pattern-recognition value while it's cheap â before Steps 3â4 investment â without committing anything on its basis.\n- Gives the human a chance to react (\"no, that's not it, it's actually closer to X\") before the formal test, catching drift early rather than after mapping work is sunk.\n- Feeds the learning loop: if the early guess and the Fork D formal five-criteria result diverge often, that's a calibration signal worth tracking, not noise to discard.\n\n**Handling rule â hard boundary:**\n- This hypothesis is recorded with a dedicated tag (`COREGUESS:<candidate-name>` or `COREGUESS:UNSET` if no guess is offered â see the tag registry above).\n- **It carries zero authority.** It does not skip, shortcut, or pre-decide the formal corespine determination that happens at Fork D (see the Corespine Determination Gate in file 4). It is discarded or confirmed only there â never treated as settled before then.\n- If the human declines to guess, that's a valid answer (`COREGUESS:UNSET`) â this question is an invitation, not an interrogation.\n\n**Governor decision needed (root Open Item #6):** should divergence between the early guess and the formal Fork D result be logged as a standing metric, or treated as a one-off observation each time? `[M]` Missing.\n\n**Required output:** a single, well-defined goal statement, produced only once the checklist is satisfied.\n\n**Learning loop:** the checklist above is presented as a **skeleton, not a rigid script**. It is expected to be part of an ongoing **learning-and-improving loop** â as CISEM runs more inputs through this stage, the checklist itself should be revised based on what gaps or false-confirmations are discovered in practice. This makes the checklist a living artifact, same as the tag registry, and any revision to it must be logged.\n\n### Step 2 Sub-Status Set (draft, non-final)\n\n| Sub-Status | Meaning |\n|---|---|\n| `GOAL-CHECKLIST-OPEN` | Checklist in progress, not all items answered |\n| `GOAL-CHECKLIST-BLOCKED` | A checklist item cannot proceed without human input not yet received |\n| `COREGUESS-LOGGED` | Early Corespine Hypothesis asked and recorded (guess or `UNSET`) â see subsection above |\n| `GOAL-DRAFTED` | Goal statement produced but not yet confirmed by the human |\n| `GOAL-CONFIRMED` | Human has explicitly confirmed the goal statement â promotes macro status to `GOAL-DEFINED` |\n\n---\n*End of file. Continue to `CISEM_Creation_Core_Spine_TRUNK-Step3-Research.md` for Step 3 and Research.*\n"},"title":"FROM CLAUDE AI BRAIN CISEM_Creation_Core_Spine_TRUNK-Steps0-2.md"},{"type":"document","source":{"type":"text","media_type":"text/plain","data":"# CISEM â Creation Core Spine & Protocol & Wizard â ROOT\n**Status:** DRAFT â Root Logic, Pending Ratification\n**Scope:** Umbrella flow governing the creation of any CISEM artifact. Corespine creation (with its own five-criteria test) is a branch beneath this root, not a parallel or replacement flow.\n**Naming flag â unresolved:** Possible collision with CS-CREATION-001 (previously flagged as ambiguously classified: Corespine vs. Gate). No formal ID assigned to this document until that is resolved by the Governor.\n**Certainty marker key used throughout the tree:** `[C]` Confirmed Â· `[I]` Inferred Â· `[A]` Assumed Â· `[M]` Missing\n\n---\n\n## Minitree Split Notice (Rev 12)\n\nThis document exceeded the constitutional 3,500-word limit (was 4,737 words as a single file) and has been split per the **minitree-split-protocol**, matching the pattern already established for the Communication corespine (root + trunk + sub-files).\n\n**Structure applied:**\n- This file is the **Root** â scope, master revision log, cross-reference index, and Open Items (Governor-facing, kept centrally rather than scattered).\n- Content is distributed across **child files** listed below, each self-contained enough to read independently but carrying pointers back to this root (per the Link-at-Every-Mention rule).\n- **Revision logging convention (resolved per this split):** this root retains the **master/consolidated revision log** as a pointer-index of milestones â it does not duplicate child content. Each child file carries its **own local revision note** for changes specific to that file only. This mirrors the existing \"Registry â  file existence\" principle: the root is the index, the children are the substance, and the two are cross-checked, not merged.\n\n---\n\n## Cross-Reference Index / Table of Contents\n\n| # | File | Contains |\n|---|---|---|\n| 1 | `CISEM_Creation_Core_Spine_ROOT.md` (this file) | Scope, master revision log, TOC, Open Items |\n| 2 | `CISEM_Creation_Core_Spine_TRUNK-Steps0-2.md` | Step 0 (Threshold, tags, statuses), Step 1 (Verified Understanding gate, AI-behavior rules), Step 2 (Mentor-Stage, checklist, Early Corespine Hypothesis) |\n| 3 | `CISEM_Creation_Core_Spine_TRUNK-Step3-Research.md` | Step 3 (Existing Landscape Mapping), Research section (three injection points, Pre-Finalization Research Prompt) |\n| 4 | `CISEM_Creation_Core_Spine_TRUNK-Step4-CorespineGate.md` | Step 4 (Fork, non-exclusive conditions AâE), Blast Risk definition, Corespine Determination Gate (\"royalty\" handling) |\n| 5 | `CISEM_Creation_Core_Spine_AppendixA-Review.md` | Formal six-expert review (Rev 10 snapshot) + cross-cutting observation, status: pending CISEM Core comment |\n\n**Consolidated state-map (per Appendix A, Expert 4's recommendation):** every macro status lives in file 2 (Step 0's table); every sub-status lives in its owning step's file (2, 3, or 4). This index is the single place that tells you which file to open for which state â resolving the \"six scattered locations\" critique without merging the content back into one file.\n\n---\n\n## Master Revision Log (Root â Consolidated Milestones)\n\n| Rev | Change | Now Lives In |\n|---|---|---|\n| 1 | Root skeleton established: Steps 0â4, non-exclusive fork logic per Governor pushback | Files 2, 3, 4 |\n| 2 | Step 0 expanded: draft tag/status lists, tags explicitly mutable | File 2 |\n| 3 | Step 1 expanded: cross-layer requirement, amicable posture, AI-behavior avoid/do list | File 2 |\n| 4 | Step 2 expanded: frictionless-via-asking principle, mentor-stage checklist, learning loop | File 2 |\n| 5 | Step 4 expanded: unique parameters per condition (AâE) | File 4 |\n| 6 | Blast Risk formally defined per Governor instruction | File 4 |\n| 7 | Research section added: three injection points + Pre-Finalization Research Prompt | File 3 |\n| 8 | Step 3 cross-referenced to Research section directly; revision logging introduced | File 3 |\n| 9 | Corespine handling added: Early Corespine Hypothesis (Step 2) + formal Corespine Determination Gate (Fork D) + reach-back rule + \"royalty\" treatment | Files 2, 4 |\n| 10 | Status sets enriched: macro/sub-status split; stage-specific sub-status tables added | Files 2, 3, 4 |\n| 11 | Appendix A added: formal six-expert review + cross-cutting observation | File 5 |\n| 12 | **This split.** Single 4,737-word document divided into Root + 4 children per minitree-split-protocol, triggered by exceeding the 3,500-word constitutional limit. Content unchanged in substance â only distributed and cross-indexed. | This file |\n| 13 | Planning synergy analysis added: Creation â Planning handoff defined (Draft Plan â Planning Domain intake), merge rejected on Zero Findings Standard grounds (second-actor independence) | This file |\n| 14 | Hierarchy proposal analysis added: Creation/Planning/Implementing/Validating â Planning confirmed as child, Implementing flagged as possibly redundant with existing Build step, Validating rejected as a child on conflict-of-interest grounds | This file |\n\n---\n\n## Creation â Planning â Relationship, Not a Merge\n\n**Confirmed, from prior CISEM work:** the Planning Domain Protocol (CISEM-ARCH-00190) already declares its own governing corespine as **CS-CREATION-001**. Planning is already positioned as subordinate to Creation, not a peer to merge with. It carries its own status machinery, independent of node lifecycle status: `AWAITING-BUILDER-REVIEW â COMMENTS-RECEIVED â CONSENSUS-REACHED â IN-PROGRESS â COMPLETE`.\n\n**Why merging Creation and Planning was rejected:** Planning's entire function depends on a **second actor** (Builder) independently reviewing and commenting before `CONSENSUS-REACHED` â this is the Zero Findings Standard in direct application: no self-certification. Creation, as built in this tree, is a first-party process (human + AI reaching a draft plan together through Steps 0â4). Merging the two risks collapsing the independent-verification step Planning exists to enforce â the same actor who drafted the plan would also get to declare it consensus-reached.\n\n**Defined synergy instead â a handoff, not a fusion:**\n\n```\nCreation Corespine (Files 2â4)              Planning Domain (CISEM-ARCH-00190)\nSteps 0â4, Corespine Gate                   external artifact, dna/planning/\n        â                                          â\n        âââ produces a Draft Plan âââââââââââââââââºâ\n                                                     â  AWAITING-BUILDER-REVIEW\n                                                     â  â COMMENTS-RECEIVED\n                                                     â  â CONSENSUS-REACHED\n                                                     â         â\n                                                     â         â¼\n                                                     â       Build\n```\n\nThis makes explicit something already implicit in File 3: the Pre-Finalization Research Prompt already refers to \"before the plan is presented for ratification\" â that language assumed a handoff destination that was never named. Planning Domain is that destination.\n\n**Open, not settled:** \"Planning corespine\" is the term in casual use, but nothing on record shows Planning ever passed the five-criteria test â it's documented as a Protocol/domain, not a ratified corespine. See Open Item #11 below.\n\n---\n\n## Hierarchy Proposal â Creation / Planning / Implementing / Validating\n\n**Proposal on the table:** Creation as parent corespine, with Planning, Implementing, and Validating as its three children.\n\n### Planning â confirmed child\nAlready established on record (CS-CREATION-001 as Planning's governing corespine, per above). No change needed; this part of the proposal simply confirms existing structure.\n\n### Implementing â status uncertain, likely redundant\n\"Implementing\" maps to **Build**, the terminal step in the already-established enforcement chain (Wizard â Protocol â Plan â Build). Before promoting it to a formal child corespine, it needs to run through the five-criteria test (the same Corespine Determination Gate mechanism built into File 4) rather than being assumed into the hierarchy by symmetry with the other two. `[M]` Missing: is \"Implementing\" anything more than the Builder role executing the Build step it already occupies? If not, adding it as a third child manufactures a corespine where an execution role with a defined place already exists.\n\n### Validating â rejected as a child of Creation\n**Point:** Validation already exists as an artifact â **CS-MASTER-VALIDATION-001** â with a known structural defect: it violates its own recurrence criterion (criterion 2, â¥2 instances) because it currently exists as singular and root-level. Making it a child of Creation, spawning one instance per Creation cycle, would genuinely fix that defect â not a cosmetic gain.\n\n**Critique â conflict of interest, not just a naming question:** Validation exists specifically to satisfy the Zero Findings Standard's second-actor requirement â independent verification, no self-certification. If Validation is a *child* of Creation, it inherits its authority from the same corespine whose output it is supposed to be independently checking. That is structurally the same problem identified above with merging Creation and Planning: the checker should not derive its authority from the thing being checked. This is a real defect in the proposal, not a stylistic objection.\n\n**Recommendation:** don't make Validating a child of Creation. Better shape: an **independent sibling corespine**, invoked *after* Creation/Planning/Build complete, reporting to a level above Creation â or directly to the Governor â not beneath it. This still solves CS-MASTER-VALIDATION-001's recurrence defect (one instance per completed cycle) without creating the conflict of interest.\n\n**Prerequisite that blocks the whole hierarchy question:** CS-CREATION-001's own classification â Corespine vs. Gate â remains an open, unresolved item from prior work (see Open Item #1). Rev 14 of a single-file draft, split at Rev 12.\"\n**trust_tier:** EXTERNAL-UNTRUSTED (external AI draft — a CLAIM to verify against CISEM's own axioms/rulings, not the Governor's voice; IBD-0008)\n**depollution_source:** none — pre-Stage-1 (captured directly into CISEM; external de-pollution not run separately)\n**depollution_pass:** no\n**PURIFIED sibling:** [[IBD-0027-creation-core-spine-brain-PURIFIED]]\n\n## RAW capture (verbatim-in-essence — the load-bearing content of the 5 Brain files)\nThis is a parallel, sophisticated DRAFT of a Creation Core Spine + Protocol + Wizard, authored by a Claude.ai \"Brain\" session, kept RAW here per ARCH-00011 §3.5. The full verbatim text is the 5 Governor-relayed documents; the load-bearing structure captured faithfully:\n\n**ROOT.** Umbrella flow for creating ANY CISEM artifact; corespine-creation is a BRANCH beneath this root (its 5-criteria test is a sub-gate), not a parallel flow. Naming collision flagged: possibly CS-CREATION-001 (unresolved). Certainty markers used: [C]onfirmed / [I]nferred / [A]ssumed / [M]issing. Split by minitree-protocol at 3,500-word limit. Carries the master revision log + Cross-Ref index + Open Items #1-13 centrally.\n\n**Step 0 — Threshold/Intake.** Input (human/AI) crosses threshold → initial tag, status=RAW. \"Nothing proceeds unformatted/untagged/unstatused.\" Draft tag families: SRC:{HUMAN|AI} · TYPE:{REQUEST|WISH|COMPLAINT|SUGGESTION} · PRIORITY:UNSET · BLAST:UNSET · COREGUESS:<name>|UNSET. MACRO status set: RAW→IN-PROCESS→VERIFIED→GOAL-DEFINED→MAPPED→FORKED→(PARKED|REJECTED|ACTIVE-BUILD). Tags = living/mutable registry; statuses = more load-bearing (higher change bar). MACRO status + per-step SUB-status = 2 coordinates.\n\n**Step 1 — Verified Understanding (UNIVERSAL MANDATORY GATE).** \"Single most repeated root cause of drift across CISEM sessions.\" Must appear in all THREE layers (Protocol, Wizard, Spine) as the SAME referenced gate, not duplicated. Amicable mutual-respect posture (not interrogation, not rubber-stamp). MECHANISM: invokes existing Reflect-Until-Match (CS-COMM-INTENT-CRYSTALLIZATION-001) + per-message WHO/WARRANT/ACTION (CS-COMMUNICATION-001) — it CALLS the mechanism, doesn't re-derive. AI-behavior AVOID: fabricating/guessing, false assumptions as fact, premature satisfaction points, silent reconciliation of conflicts, dropping any open item. DO: state confirmed vs inferred vs assumed vs missing separately; name gaps aloud; allow/expect confrontation for excellence; reach ACTUAL consensus before promoting to VERIFIED. Sub-status: UNDERSTANDING-DRAFTED/DISPUTED/PARTIAL/CONFIRMED.\n\n**Step 2 — Mentor-Stage: Deep Cause & Goal Definition.** Frictionless-without-skipping = always ASK the human directly, don't infer silently. Checklist (living skeleton): surface request restated → underlying problem/friction → what \"solved\" looks like concretely → is goal independent or a symptom of a deeper goal → unstated constraints → human confirms goal in own words → Early Corespine Hypothesis (COREGUESS, speculative, zero-authority, re-tested only at Fork D). Mentor vibe (surface a goal unclear even to the requester); \"sounding focused ≠ being focused.\" Cognitive-load flag: batch into 2-3 exchanges. Sub-status: GOAL-CHECKLIST-OPEN/BLOCKED, COREGUESS-LOGGED, GOAL-DRAFTED, GOAL-CONFIRMED.\n\n**Step 3 — Existing Landscape Mapping + Research.** Map all relevant CISEM elements (evidence, not conclusion). Research is NOT a standalone step (would float) — it's a CAPABILITY invoked at 3 points: Step-2 checklist item, Step-3 (this step IS research), Fork-D Import-vs-Create. Pre-Finalization Research Prompt runs ONCE at draft-plan stage before ratification (known-solution-pattern / existing-frameworks / recent-warnings; report only what changes the plan). No-findings is logged (auditable). Sub-status: MAPPING-IN-PROGRESS/CONFLICT-FLAGGED/COMPLETE, RESEARCH-PASS-PENDING/COMPLETE-NO-FINDINGS/COMPLETE-FINDINGS-INTEGRATED.\n\n**Step 4 — Fork (NON-EXCLUSIVE conditions A-E).** A=Already-Exists-Operational (terminal; unique param Awareness Gap; output=DISCLOSURE not build). B=Enhancement (param Modification Surface; most gated by Blast Risk). C=Wiring/Bundling (param Connection Topology; NO content mutation — distinguishes from B). D=New-Element-Required (param Import-vs-Create + Schema-Slot-Assignment; highest blast). E=Out-of-Scope (terminal; action undecided: reject|park|escalate). B/C/D combinable into a composite path. Sub-status: FORK-CANDIDATE/CONFIRMED-SINGLE/CONFIRMED-COMPOSITE/PARKED/REJECTED/ESCALATED.\n\n**Blast Risk.** Potential ripple significance of a change across related + increasingly-distant elements. Governs rigor (inherits Proportional Gate Strength, not a parallel concept). [M] scale/threshold undefined.\n\n**Corespine Determination Gate (\"royalty\").** The formal corespine question is tested ONLY at Fork D (only there does something NEW enter the dependency graph), BEFORE Schema-Slot-Assignment. Run the 5-criteria test (criterion 3 = independent goal, empirically the discriminator, checked first). Pass → corespine-specific creation path REPLACES normal slot assignment. Fail → regular element. REACH-BACK: if the element enhanced (B) or rewired (C) IS ALREADY a corespine, that status is inherited automatically (check at start of B/C). Royalty treatment: Governor explicit sign-off; elevated Blast-Risk floor by default; NO fast-path shortcut ever. Sub-status: FIVE-CRITERIA-PENDING/RUNNING, COREGUESS-CONFIRMED/OVERTURNED/REJECTED, ROYALTY-CONFIRMED/ESCALATED-B/C/RATIFICATION-PENDING.\n\n**Creation ↔ Planning — handoff, not merge.** Planning (ARCH-00190) already declares CS-CREATION-001 as its governing corespine → already subordinate to Creation. Merge REJECTED on Zero-Findings second-actor grounds (Planning needs an independent Builder to reach CONSENSUS-REACHED; merging collapses the independent-verification). Implementing = likely redundant with existing Build step / Builder role (needs the 5-criteria test before promotion). Validating = REJECTED as child — conflict of interest: a checker must not derive authority from the thing it checks (same defect as merging Creation+Planning). This also fixes CS-MASTER-VALIDATION-001's recurrence-criterion defect (one instance per cycle). BLOCKED prerequisite: CS-CREATION-001's own Corespine-vs-Gate classification is unresolved.\n\n**Appendix A — six-expert review (Rev 10 snapshot).** (1) Architect: macro/sub-status split has no transition table → drift; make macro DERIVED from sub-status (one source). (2) Governance/Risk: Blast Risk gates a decision while its own scale is [M] — enforcing on an undefined metric. (3) Cognitive/UX: Step 2 stacks too much serially → batch. B/C/D combine into a composite path. This is **exactly** the \"restate-meaning-back + name-your-assumptions\" mechanism we hypothesized — now with a worked design. STRONGLY adopt.\n2. **Fork A-E (non-exclusive)** — a richer intake-resolution model than our plain \"create\": **A** Already-Exists → *disclosure* (Awareness Gap — the answer is \"it exists, here it is\", not a build); **B** Enhancement; **C** Wiring/Bundling (no content mutation); **D** New-Element; **E** Out-of-Scope. B/C/D combine into a composite path. This is a real upgrade to how the pipeline decides what an input becomes.\n3. **Corespine Determination at Fork D only** (something NEW enters the graph) — resolves WHERE corespine-classification happens, and the **reach-back rule** (touching an existing corespine inherits royalty even for a small edit). Clean.\n4. **Validating = independent SIBLING, not a child** (a checker must not derive authority from what it checks) — directly answers the Governor's hierarchy question and fixes CS-MASTER-VALIDATION-001's recurrence defect. Adopt the reasoning.\n5. **Creation→Planning = handoff, not merge** (second-actor independence, Zero-Findings) — confirms Planning-as-child + the handoff.\n\n## SYNERGY — how it MERGES with what we've already built/agreed\n- Their **Step 1** = our **Step 0** (understanding-verification). Their Reflect-Until-Match + AVOID/DO list = the mechanism for our Step 0. → the \"walk to find the form\" is largely answered; we test-run to confirm.\n- Their **Blast Risk / Proportional Gate Strength** = our **depth levels D1/D2/D3**. Same idea (rigor scales to ripple). Merge: Blast Risk is the *metric*; D1/D2/D3 are the *bands*; the **depth-orchestrator** is what reads Blast Risk and picks the band.\n- Their **Open Item #9 (triviality fast-lane, \"not yet designed\")** = **our depth-orchestrator + D3 swift lane.** We designed the thing they flagged as missing.\n- Their **Open Item #5 enforcement-level (\"MOST load-bearing, undeclared\")** = **already RESOLVED in CISEM: mechanical-over-behavioral** (CAL, plan-audit, creation-gate, deletion-guard, functional-check). We are ahead here — this de-risks their biggest worry.\n- Their **macro+sub-status 2-coordinate model** ↔ our tags/statuses governance surface + creation-gate. Compatible; the macro/sub split is worth considering.\n\n## CONFLICTS / RECONCILE BEFORE ADOPTING (do NOT silently merge — Step 0!)\n- **Naming: CS-CREATION-001 already exists** in this repo as the ratified apex creation corespine (ARCH-00397). The Brain's \"Creation Core Spine ROOT\" is a DIFFERENT artifact claiming possibly the same ID. → reconcile: is the Brain draft the *content* of CS-CREATION-001, or a new node? (Their Open Item #1 = our decision.)\n- **Their \"Reflect-Until-Match / WHO-WARRANT-ACTION\" IDs** — unverified in-repo; adopt the concept, not the IDs, until grep confirms.\n- **Blast-Risk scale [M]** — undefined by them; we should define it as the D1/D2/D3 banding (our depth levels give it the scale they lack).\n- **Macro-status derived-vs-maintained** (their Expert-1) — an open design choice; ties to our status-enum reconciliation follow-on.\n\n## OPEN ITEMS worth carrying into our discussion (theirs, filtered to what matters for us)\n- Fork-E terminal action (reject|park|escalate) — maps to our threshold REJECT/PARK.\n- Fork-A disclosure format (how \"it already exists\" is surfaced).\n- COREGUESS early-hypothesis: keep as a bounded, zero-authority guess re-tested at Fork D? (nice learning-loop signal.)\n- Triviality/fast-lane → resolved by depth-orchestrator (confirm).\n- Validating restructure → independent sibling (confirm + who it reports to).\n\n## NET (for the discussion — not a decision)\nThis Brain draft is a **parallel, more-elaborated draft of the same creation process we are designing.** It does NOT replace ours — it **validates Step 0, hands us the Reflect-Until-Match form we were going to walk out, adds the Fork A-E resolution model + the corespine-gate-at-D + the validating-as-sibling insight**, and its two biggest open worries (enforcement-level, fast-lane) are **already solved on the CISEM side** (mechanical enforcement; depth-orchestrator). The full verbatim text is the 5 Governor-relayed documents; the load-bearing structure captured faithfully:\n\n**ROOT.** Umbrella flow for creating ANY CISEM artifact; corespine-creation is a BRANCH beneath this root (its 5-criteria test is a sub-gate), not a parallel flow. Naming collision flagged: possibly CS-CREATION-001 (unresolved). Certainty markers used: [C]onfirmed / [I]nferred / [A]ssumed / [M]issing. Split by minitree-protocol at 3,500-word limit. Carries the master revision log + Cross-Ref index + Open Items #1-13 centrally.\n\n**Step 0 — Threshold/Intake.** Input (human/AI) crosses threshold → initial tag, status=RAW. \"Nothing proceeds unformatted/untagged/unstatused.\" Draft tag families: SRC:{HUMAN|AI} · TYPE:{REQUEST|WISH|COMPLAINT|SUGGESTION} · PRIORITY:UNSET · BLAST:UNSET · COREGUESS:<name>|UNSET. MACRO status set: RAW→IN-PROCESS→VERIFIED→GOAL-DEFINED→MAPPED→FORKED→(PARKED|REJECTED|ACTIVE-BUILD). Tags = living/mutable registry; statuses = more load-bearing (higher change bar). MACRO status + per-step SUB-status = 2 coordinates.\n\n**Step 1 — Verified Understanding (UNIVERSAL MANDATORY GATE).** \"Single most repeated root cause of drift across CISEM sessions.\" Must appear in all THREE layers (Protocol, Wizard, Spine) as the SAME referenced gate, not duplicated. Amicable mutual-respect posture (not interrogation, not rubber-stamp). MECHANISM: invokes existing Reflect-Until-Match (CS-COMM-INTENT-CRYSTALLIZATION-001) + per-message WHO/WARRANT/ACTION (CS-COMMUNICATION-001) — it CALLS the mechanism, doesn't re-derive. AI-behavior AVOID: fabricating/guessing, false assumptions as fact, premature satisfaction points, silent reconciliation of conflicts, dropping any open item. DO: state confirmed vs inferred vs assumed vs missing separately; name gaps aloud; allow/expect confrontation for excellence; reach ACTUAL consensus before promoting to VERIFIED. Sub-status: UNDERSTANDING-DRAFTED/DISPUTED/PARTIAL/CONFIRMED.\n\n**Step 2 — Mentor-Stage: Deep Cause & Goal Definition.** Frictionless-without-skipping = always ASK the human directly, don't infer silently. Checklist (living skeleton): surface request restated → underlying problem/friction → what \"solved\" looks like concretely → is goal independent or a symptom of a deeper goal → unstated constraints → human confirms goal in own words → Early Corespine Hypothesis (COREGUESS, speculative, zero-authority, re-tested only at Fork D). Mentor vibe (surface a goal unclear even to the requester); \"sounding focused ≠ being focused.\" Cognitive-load flag: batch into 2-3 exchanges. Sub-status: GOAL-CHECKLIST-OPEN/BLOCKED, COREGUESS-LOGGED, GOAL-DRAFTED, GOAL-CONFIRMED.\n\n**Step 3 — Existing Landscape Mapping + Research.** Map all relevant CISEM elements (evidence, not conclusion). Research is NOT a standalone step (would float) — it's a CAPABILITY invoked at 3 points: Step-2 checklist item, Step-3 (this step IS research), Fork-D Import-vs-Create. Pre-Finalization Research Prompt runs ONCE at draft-plan stage before ratification (known-solution-pattern / existing-frameworks / recent-warnings; report only what changes the plan). No-findings is logged (auditable). Sub-status: MAPPING-IN-PROGRESS/CONFLICT-FLAGGED/COMPLETE, RESEARCH-PASS-PENDING/COMPLETE-NO-FINDINGS/COMPLETE-FINDINGS-INTEGRATED.\n\n**Step 4 — Fork (NON-EXCLUSIVE conditions A-E).** A=Already-Exists-Operational (terminal; unique param Awareness Gap; output=DISCLOSURE not build). B=Enhancement (param Modification Surface; most gated by Blast Risk). C=Wiring/Bundling (param Connection Topology; NO content mutation — distinguishes from B). D=New-Element-Required (param Import-vs-Create + Schema-Slot-Assignment; highest blast). E=Out-of-Scope (terminal; action undecided: reject|park|escalate). B/C/D combinable into a composite path. Sub-status: FORK-CANDIDATE/CONFIRMED-SINGLE/CONFIRMED-COMPOSITE/PARKED/REJECTED/ESCALATED.\n\n**Blast Risk.** Potential ripple significance of a change across related + increasingly-distant elements. Governs rigor (inherits Proportional Gate Strength, not a parallel concept). [M] scale/threshold undefined.\n\n**Corespine Determination Gate (\"royalty\").** The formal corespine question is tested ONLY at Fork D (only there does something NEW enter the dependency graph), BEFORE Schema-Slot-Assignment. Run the 5-criteria test (criterion 3 = independent goal, empirically the discriminator, checked first). Pass → corespine-specific creation path REPLACES normal slot assignment. Fail → regular element. REACH-BACK: if the element enhanced (B) or rewired (C) IS ALREADY a corespine, that status is inherited automatically (check at start of B/C). Royalty treatment: Governor explicit sign-off; elevated Blast-Risk floor by default; NO fast-path shortcut ever. Sub-status: FIVE-CRITERIA-PENDING/RUNNING, COREGUESS-CONFIRMED/OVERTURNED/REJECTED, ROYALTY-CONFIRMED/ESCALATED-B/C/RATIFICATION-PENDING.\n\n**Creation ↔ Planning — handoff, not merge.** Planning (ARCH-00190) already declares CS-CREATION-001 as its governing corespine → already subordinate to Creation. Merge REJECTED on Zero-Findings second-actor grounds (Planning needs an independent Builder to reach CONSENSUS-REACHED; merging collapses the independent-verification). Synergy = Creation produces a Draft Plan → hands off to Planning Domain intake.\n\n**Hierarchy — Creation parent; Planning/Implementing/Validating children?** Planning = confirmed child. Implementing = likely redundant with existing Build step / Builder role (needs the 5-criteria test before promotion). Validating = REJECTED as child — conflict of interest: a checker must not derive authority from the thing it checks (same defect as merging Creation+Planning). Better: Validating = independent SIBLING corespine, invoked AFTER Creation/Planning/Build, reporting above Creation / to Governor. This also fixes CS-MASTER-VALIDATION-001's recurrence-criterion defect (one instance per cycle). {"parentUuid":"43fdf1ba-6bbb-4861-8c56-5ddf6b5712a1","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-4-8","id":"msg_011CdE6LmhvDXkyWXwKvuwgw","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01F2z7cssErrZCQMiJQvaCdi","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"c:\\Users\\finky\\Desktop\\Claude Code\\Cisem\\dna\\planning\\creation-process-merge-design-2026-07-21.md","content":"# Creation Process — Merged Design (in progress, consensus-pending)\n**tags:** [creation-process, design, merge, step-0, depth-levels, orchestrator, fork, corespine-gate, boundary-survival]\n**Status:** DRAFT (Governor + Opus reaching consensus 2026-07-21; NOT formalized/coded — awaits draft→test-run→formalize)\n**Sources merged:** this session's design (Step 0, depth levels, orchestrator) + [[IBD-0027-creation-core-spine-brain-PURIFIED]] (Claude-Brain draft: Step-1 Verified-Understanding/Reflect-Until-Match, Fork A-E, corespine-gate-at-D, Validating-as-sibling). Governor: \"we don't have to be loyal to previous decisions if a better path aligns with CISEM.\"\n\n## SHAPE (Governor-confirmed): MUTUAL MANDATORY STEPS → then FORKS\nEvery input runs the mandatory steps in order; then forks by what it resolves to. Depth/blast scales the RIGOR of each, but the SEQUENCE is universal.\n\n### MANDATORY STEPS (every input, in order)\n- **STEP 0 — UNDERSTANDING-VERIFICATION** (the true first act; prior even to the goal). The listener RESTATES the source's *meaning in its own words* + NAMES its assumptions; source confirms/corrects; loop until CONFIRMED (Reflect-Until-Match form, adopted from IBD-0027 as a CONCEPT — the Brain IDs CS-COMM-* are not-in-repo, external). AVOID list: no fabrication, no false-assumptions-as-fact, no premature satisfaction points, no silent conflict-reconciliation, drop nothing. DO: separate confirmed/inferred/assumed/missing; name gaps aloud; allow confrontation. WHY it's non-trivial: felt-understanding ≠ actual-understanding (RI: the plausibility trap at the level of MEANING) — the single most-repeated root cause of drift; cheapest fix here, most expensive later. Must appear in all 3 layers (Protocol/Wizard/Pipeline) as ONE referenced gate, not duplicated.\n- **STEP 1 — GOAL-SETTING** (was GATE 0; goal is prior, shared root of CoreSpine + CoreSpiral). Mentor-stage: ASK the human directly (frictionless-without-skipping); checklist (surface request → underlying friction → what \"solved\" looks like → independent-or-symptom → unstated constraints → human confirms in own words → Early Corespine Hypothesis COREGUESS = bounded/zero-authority guess). Output: one confirmed goal (DO/DON'T target). Input stamped `goal-connected`.\n- **STEP 2 — EXISTING LANDSCAPE MAPPING + RESEARCH** (evidence, not conclusion). Map all relevant CISEM elements. Research is NOT a standalone step — a capability invoked at 3 points (Step-1 checklist, this step, Fork-D import). Pre-Finalization Research Prompt runs once at draft stage; no-findings is logged (auditable).\n- **DEPTH ORCHESTRATOR** (the missing piece, confirmed gap). Reads Blast Risk / significance → classifies **D1 KERNEL / D2 DOMAIN / D3 INSTANCE** → dispatches the matching rigor AND tier (one orchestrator, two decisions: depth then tier; D1→Opus-led+council+Governor-ratify, D2→§3 gates+plan+Opus, D3→swift creation-gate-minimum). This IS the triviality \"fast-lane\" the Brain flagged as missing (their Open Item #9). Blast Risk = the metric; D1/D2/D3 = the bands (gives Blast Risk the scale it lacked).\n\n### FORK (after the mandatory steps; NON-EXCLUSIVE conditions A-E; B/C/D combinable)\n- **A — Already-Exists-Operational** → terminal; output = DISCLOSURE (surface the existing element; the gap was AWARENESS, not capability). No build.\n- **B — Enhancement** → modify an existing element (Modification Surface); most gated by blast.\n- **C — Wiring/Bundling** → new relationships only, NO content mutation (distinguishes from B).\n- **D — New Element Required** → Import-vs-Create sub-fork + Schema-Slot-Assignment (never floating).\n- **E — Out-of-Scope** → terminal; action = reject | park | escalate (maps to threshold REJECT/PARK).\n\n### CORESPINE DETERMINATION (Governor's question, answered)\n= \"does this input relate to an EXISTING corespine, or is it a CANDIDATE for a NEW one?\" Asked ONCE, at the right moment:\n- At **Fork D** (something new enters the graph): run the 5-criteria test (criterion 3 = independent goal, the discriminator, first). PASS → corespine-specific creation path replaces normal slot-assignment (royalty: Governor sign-off, elevated blast floor, no shortcut). FAIL → regular new element.\n- At **Fork B/C** (touching an existing element): **reach-back** — if that element already IS a corespine, inherit its status + rigor automatically (check at start of B/C). Don't re-test.\n\n### OUTPUT → INHERITANCE → AUDIT\nOutput element DECLARES/USES its corespine (A2 inheritance) → born governed (creation-gate: tag+status) → ZF.\n\n## HIERARCHY (Creation as parent)\n- **Planning = confirmed child** (ARCH-00190 already declares CS-CREATION-001 as its corespine). Creation→Planning is a HANDOFF (Creation produces a Draft Plan → Planning Domain intake), NOT a merge (second-actor independence / Zero-Findings — the drafter can't also declare consensus-reached).\n- **Implementing = likely redundant with the existing Build step** — must pass the 5-criteria test before being promoted (don't manufacture a corespine by symmetry).\n- **Validating = independent SIBLING, not a child** — a checker must not derive authority from what it checks (conflict of interest). Invoked AFTER Creation/Planning/Build; reports above Creation / to Governor. Also fixes CS-MASTER-VALIDATION-001's recurrence defect (one instance per cycle).\n\n## STATUS ARCHITECTURE (from IBD-0027, to reconcile with our tags/status)\n2 coordinates: MACRO status (RAW→IN-PROCESS→VERIFIED→GOAL-DEFINED→MAPPED→FORKED→ACTIVE-BUILD/PARKED/REJECTED) + per-step SUB-status. Open: make macro DERIVED from sub-status (one source) vs maintained separately.\n\n## OPEN ITEMS (carried, for consensus)\n1. **CS-CREATION-001 naming** — the Brain's \"Creation Core Spine ROOT\" vs our ratified apex CS-CREATION-001 (ARCH-00397): is the Brain draft the CONTENT of CS-CREATION-001, or a new node? (→ handled by the permanent external-input PCR, see [[creation-external-input-default-and-pcr-2026-07-21]].)\n2. Blast Risk scale = define as the D1/D2/D3 banding.\n3. COREGUESS calibration metric (log early-guess vs Fork-D result divergence?).\n4. Fork-A disclosure format; Fork-E terminal action.\n5. Status macro-derived-vs-maintained.\n6. Where Validating-sibling reports.\n\n## NEXT (the agreed workflow): discuss → consensus → draft → TEST-RUN (walk it) → consolidate chat+files+test → formalize (only then code).\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":3462,"cache_read_input_tokens":850298,"output_tokens":12228,"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":3462,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"not_available","iterations":[{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":12228,"cache_read_input_tokens":850298,"cache_creation_input_tokens":3462,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":3462},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard"},"diagnostics":null},"requestId":"req_011CdE6Lbymi7Zj9LtYSbeoF","type":"assistant","uuid":"ece4433f-a8ca-4ec2-8074-c74e11a4bd6a","timestamp":"2026-07-20T22:27:05.308Z","userType":"external","entrypoint":"claude-vscode","cwd":"c:\\Users\\finky\\Desktop\\Claude Code\\Cisem","sessionId":"c249d411-23b2-46c5-9695-ddbaf884b7de","version":"2.1.210","gitBranch":"main","slug":"mutable-dazzling-blanket"}

Governor: \"we don't have to be loyal to previous decisions if a better path aligns with CISEM.\"\n\n## SHAPE (Governor-confirmed): MUTUAL MANDATORY STEPS → then FORKS\nEvery input runs the mandatory steps in order; then forks by what it resolves to. Depth/blast scales the RIGOR of each, but the SEQUENCE is universal.\n\n### MANDATORY STEPS (every input, in order)\n- **STEP 0 — UNDERSTANDING-VERIFICATION** (the true first act; prior even to the goal). The listener RESTATES the source's *meaning in its own words* + NAMES its assumptions; source confirms/corrects; loop until CONFIRMED (Reflect-Until-Match form, adopted from IBD-0027 as a CONCEPT — the Brain IDs CS-COMM-* are not-in-repo, external). AVOID list: no fabrication, no false-assumptions-as-fact, no premature satisfaction points, no silent conflict-reconciliation, drop nothing. DO: separate confirmed/inferred/assumed/missing; name gaps aloud; allow confrontation. WHY it's non-trivial: felt-understanding ≠ actual-understanding (RI: the plausibility trap at the level of MEANING) — the single most-repeated root cause of drift; cheapest fix here, most expensive later. Must appear in all 3 layers (Protocol/Wizard/Pipeline) as ONE referenced gate, not duplicated.\n- **STEP 1 — GOAL-SETTING** (was GATE 0; goal is prior, shared root of CoreSpine + CoreSpiral). Mentor-stage: ASK the human directly (frictionless-without-skipping); checklist (surface request → underlying friction → what \"solved\" looks like → independent-or-symptom → unstated constraints → human confirms in own words → Early Corespine Hypothesis COREGUESS = bounded/zero-authority guess). Output: one confirmed goal (DO/DON'T target). Input stamped `goal-connected`.\n- **STEP 2 — EXISTING LANDSCAPE MAPPING + RESEARCH** (evidence, not conclusion). Map all relevant CISEM elements. Research is NOT a standalone step — a capability invoked at 3 points (Step-1 checklist, this step, Fork-D import). Pre-Finalization Research Prompt runs once at draft stage; no-findings is logged (auditable).\n- **DEPTH ORCHESTRATOR** (the missing piece, confirmed gap). Reads Blast Risk / significance → classifies **D1 KERNEL / D2 DOMAIN / D3 INSTANCE** → dispatches the matching rigor AND tier (one orchestrator, two decisions: depth then tier; D1→Opus-led+council+Governor-ratify, D2→§3 gates+plan+Opus, D3→swift creation-gate-minimum). This IS the triviality \"fast-lane\" the Brain flagged as missing (their Open Item #9). Blast Risk = the metric; D1/D2/D3 = the bands (gives Blast Risk the scale it lacked).\n\n### FORK (after the mandatory steps; NON-EXCLUSIVE conditions A-E; B/C/D combinable)\n- **A — Already-Exists-Operational** → terminal; output = DISCLOSURE (surface the existing element; the gap was AWARENESS, not capability). No build.\n- **B — Enhancement** → modify an existing element (Modification Surface); most gated by blast.\n- **C — Wiring/Bundling** → new relationships only, NO content mutation (distinguishes from B).\n- **D — New Element Required** → Import-vs-Create sub-fork + Schema-Slot-Assignment (never floating).\n- **E — Out-of-Scope** → terminal; action = reject | park | escalate (maps to threshold REJECT/PARK).\n\n### CORESPINE DETERMINATION (Governor's question, answered)\n= \"does this input relate to an EXISTING corespine, or is it a CANDIDATE for a NEW one?\" Asked ONCE, at the right moment:\n- At **Fork D** (something new enters the graph): run the 5-criteria test (criterion 3 = independent goal, the discriminator, first). PASS → corespine-specific creation path replaces normal slot-assignment (royalty: Governor sign-off, elevated blast floor, no shortcut). FAIL → regular new element.\n- At **Fork B/C** (touching an existing element): **reach-back** — if that element already IS a corespine, inherit its status + rigor automatically (check at start of B/C). Don't re-test.\n\n### OUTPUT → INHERITANCE → AUDIT\nOutput element DECLARES/USES its corespine (A2 inheritance) → born governed (creation-gate: tag+status) → ZF.\n\n## HIERARCHY (Creation as parent)\n- **Planning = confirmed child** (ARCH-00190 already declares CS-CREATION-001 as its corespine). Creation→Planning is a HANDOFF (Creation produces a Draft Plan → Planning Domain intake), NOT a merge (second-actor independence / Zero-Findings — the drafter can't also declare consensus-reached).\n- **Implementing = likely redundant with the existing Build step** — must pass the 5-criteria test before being promoted (don't manufacture a corespine by symmetry).\n- **Validating = independent SIBLING, not a child** — a checker must not derive authority from what it checks (conflict of interest). Invoked AFTER Creation/Planning/Build; reports above Creation / to Governor. Also fixes CS-MASTER-VALIDATION-001's recurrence defect (one instance per cycle).\n\n## STATUS ARCHITECTURE (from IBD-0027, to reconcile with our tags/status)\n2 coordinates: MACRO status (RAW→IN-PROCESS→VERIFIED→GOAL-DEFINED→MAPPED→FORKED→ACTIVE-BUILD/PARKED/REJECTED) + per-step SUB-status. Open: make macro DERIVED from sub-status (one source) vs maintained separately.\n\n## OPEN ITEMS (carried, for consensus)\n1. **CS-CREATION-001 naming** — the Brain's \"Creation Core Spine ROOT\" vs our ratified apex CS-CREATION-001 (ARCH-00397): is the Brain draft the CONTENT of CS-CREATION-001, or a new node? (→ handled by the permanent external-input PCR, see [[creation-external-input-default-and-pcr-2026-07-21]].)\n2. Blast Risk scale = define as the D1/D2/D3 banding.\n3. COREGUESS calibration metric (log early-guess vs Fork-D result divergence?).\n4. Fork-A disclosure format; Fork-E terminal action.\n5. Status macro-derived-vs-maintained.\n6. Where Validating-sibling reports.\n\n## NEXT (the agreed workflow): discuss → consensus → draft → TEST-RUN (walk it) → consolidate chat+files+test → formalize (only then code).\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"ece4433f-a8ca-4ec2-8074-c74e11a4bd6a","userType":"external","entrypoint":"claude-vscode","cwd":"c:\\Users\\finky\\Desktop\\Claude Code\\Cisem","sessionId":"c249d411-23b2-46c5-9695-ddbaf884b7de","version":"2.1.210","gitBranch":"main","slug":"mutable-dazzling-blanket"}

{"parentUuid":"14a10230-1827-4b29-8c52-6a77e7a6de98","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-4-8","id":"msg_011CdE6Zf8Q3oakaN8YKv8yV","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"Now the permanent PCR + external-input default you demanded (formalize how such situations are handled):"}],"stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":12306,"cache_read_input_tokens":853760,"output_tokens":2235,"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":12306,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"not_available","iterations":[{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":2235,"cache_read_input_tokens":853760,"cache_creation_input_tokens":12306,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":12306},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard"},"diagnostics":null},"requestId":"req_011CdE6ZLBNDJW3Kq5PA1kek","type":"assistant","uuid":"6d1be172-5e24-4100-b291-ab3ccf8bd876","timestamp":"2026-07-20T22:27:26.218Z","userType":"external","entrypoint":"claude-vscode","cwd":"c:\\Users\\finky\\Desktop\\Claude Code\\Cisem","sessionId":"c249d411-23b2-46c5-9695-ddbaf884b7de","version":"2.1.210","gitBranch":"main","slug":"mutable-dazzling-blanket"}
{"parentUuid":"6d1be172-5e24-4100-b291-ab3ccf8bd876","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-4-8","id":"msg_011CdE6Zf8Q3oakaN8YKv8yV","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_0191mH4oZvsGUP5EHHBiYXFf","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"c:\\Users\\finky\\Desktop\\Claude Code\\Cisem\\dna\\creation-external-input-default-and-pcr-2026-07-21.md","content":"# External-Input Handling — DEFAULT + Permanent PCR (Governor decree 2026-07-21)\n**tags:** [external-input, intake, default-handling, pcr, id-collision, governance, permanent]\n**Status:** DECLARED (Governor-decreed default; enforced mechanically where possible)\n**Why:** the Governor: \"formalize this as default in the way situations like that are handled\" + \"permanently PCR this situation with reasoning — do it and enforce it.\" Born from the Claude-Brain Creation-Core-Spine intake (IBD-0027), where the input (a) may claim an existing CISEM ID (CS-CREATION-001) and (b) cited unverified external IDs (CS-COMM-*, not-in-repo).\n\n## THE DEFAULT — how ANY external input is handled (dogfoods ARCH-00405 intake + Step 0)\nMandatory sequence, every external input (from a coworker AI, Brain session, web, another platform):\n1. **STEP 0 — Understanding-Verification** first: restate what the source meant + name assumptions; confirm.\n2. **CAPTURE as RAW-EXTERNAL** — verbatim, provenance-stamped (`source:`, `trust_tier: EXTERNAL-UNTRUSTED`, `depollution_source/pass:`), APPEND-ONLY, never edited (ARCH-00011 §3.5). External content is a CLAIM to verify, never the Governor's voice (IBD-0008).\n3. **PURIFY** into a de-branded PURIFIED sibling — strip the source's scaffolding/coined IDs; keep only the transferable essence; every cited external ID is `not-in-repo` until grep-verified (the `[I1]` intake gate enforces this — it caught CS-COMM-* on IBD-0027).\n4. **ABSORB (expert extraction)** — what serves CISEM, what conflicts, what CISEM already resolved; present for discussion. Adopt CONCEPTS, not external IDs.\n5. **CONSENSUS before formalizing** — nothing is built/merged from external input until Governor+Opus consensus. Reach it through discuss → draft → test-run → consolidate → formalize.\nNEVER: adopt an external design wholesale, cite an external ID as if in-repo, or formalize before consensus.\n\n## PERMANENT PCR — external input claims/uses a CISEM ID that already exists or is unverified\n**Problem:** an external draft names an ID that (a) already exists in the repo with different content (collision), or (b) does not exist in the repo at all (unverified/coined).\n\n**Cause:** external sources coin or reuse IDs in their own namespace; treating them as CISEM-authoritative fabricates references and risks overwriting a ratified node (A8 fork; the exact `[I1]` dangling / naming-collision class).\n\n**Resolution (ENFORCED):**\n- **Case (a) — collision with an existing ratified node** (e.g. CS-CREATION-001 = our apex ARCH-00397, vs the Brain's \"Creation Core Spine ROOT\"): the external artifact does NOT inherit the ID. Decide explicitly: is it the **CONTENT of the existing node** (→ merge into it, existing node keeps its ID + ratification) or a **genuinely new node** (→ new ID via the one gate)? Default when uncertain: treat as content-for-merge into the existing node, never silently create a second node with the same ID (A8/I19). Governor rules the ambiguous case.\n- **Case (b) — unverified/coined external ID** (e.g. CS-COMM-*): mark `not-in-repo, external` at every mention (so `[I1]` excludes it); adopt the underlying CONCEPT under a CISEM-owned name if valuable; never cite the external ID as resolvable.\n\n**Enforcement (mechanical + behavioral):**\n- `[RAW-PAIR]` requires provenance on every RAW-EXTERNAL file; `[I1]` flags any cited ID that doesn't resolve and isn't tagged external/not-in-repo (proven live on IBD-0027).\n- Behavioral: this default is Step-0-gated and stated in CLAUDE.md; a merge that reuses an existing ID must show the collision was ruled (content-merge vs new-node), not assumed.\n- GI-55 indexes this decree.\n\n## RECOMMENDATION for the live case (CS-CREATION-001)\nThe Brain \"Creation Core Spine ROOT\" is the **content/design for our existing CS-CREATION-001**, merged into the creation-process design ([[creation-process-merge-design-2026-07-21]]) — NOT a new node. CS-CREATION-001 keeps its ID (ARCH-00397) and ratification. (Governor to confirm.)\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":12306,"cache_read_input_tokens":853760,"output_tokens":2235,"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":12306,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"not_available","iterations":[{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":2235,"cache_read_input_tokens":853760,"cache_creation_input_tokens":12306,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":12306},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard"},"diagnostics":null},"requestId":"req_011CdE6ZLBNDJW3Kq5PA1kek","type":"assistant","uuid":"0f362524-320b-4e9a-a907-ae0d2e2e51ed","timestamp":"2026-07-20T22:27:49.791Z","userType":"external","entrypoint":"claude-vscode","cwd":"c:\\Users\\finky\\Desktop\\Claude Code\\Cisem","sessionId":"c249d411-23b2-46c5-9695-ddbaf884b7de","version":"2.1.210","gitBranch":"main","slug":"mutable-dazzling-blanket"}
